items.title_en: Firefox is now the last major browser that still supports uBlock Origin
items.title_zh: Firefox 成为仍支持 uBlock Origin 的最后一款主流浏览器
items.summary_en: Firefox remains the last major browser to support uBlock Origin, as others shift away from traditional ad-block extensions due to evolving extension policies. This preserves a familiar privacy tool for Firefox users but underscores growing fragmentation in how browsers handle ad blocking.
items.summary_zh: Firefox 仍然是主流浏览器中最后一个支持 uBlock Origin 的选择。随着其他浏览器因扩展策略和 MV3 变更而削弱对这类扩展的支持，Firefox 的隐私保护能力仍具吸引力，但也暴露出浏览器扩展生态的分化。

items.title_en: Qwen 3.8 27B
items.title_zh: Qwen 3.8-27B 模型
items.summary_en: Qwen 3.8-27B FP8 marks another step toward accessible, efficient LLMs. The 27B parameter model is optimized for FP8 inference, enabling faster runs on commodity GPUs and lower memory footprints, helping hobbyists and small teams experiment with large models.
items.summary_zh: Qwen 3.8-27B FP8 提供更高效的推理，27亿参数在普通显卡上也能更快地跑，显存需求更低，便于个人和小团队尝试大模型。

items.title_en: Tracking down the 16-year-old WAL-reset SQLite bug
items.title_zh: 追踪这起持续16年的 SQLite WAL 重置漏洞
items.summary_en: Researchers zero in on a long-standing SQLite WAL reset bug that has persisted for 16 years. The issue can cause data integrity problems when the write-ahead logging file resets under certain conditions, impacting apps using WAL mode. The takeaway is to test WAL edge cases and ensure robust backup/restore paths, highlighting SQLite quirks in real-world apps.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员锁定一宗持续了16年的 SQLite WAL 重置漏洞。该问题在特定条件下会导致写入前日志文件重置时的数据完整性问题，影响使用 WAL 模式的应用程序。建议开发者测试 WAL 的边界情况，并确保备份/恢复路径健全，凸显实际应用中 SQLite 的潜在坑点。

items.title_en: Muse Glimmer: 30B-parameter model optimized for always-on local agent workflows
items.title_zh: Muse Glimmer：面向持续本地代理工作流优化的30B参数模型
items.summary_en: Muse Glimmer is a 30B-parameter model optimized for always-on local agent workflows, enabling persistent autonomous agents with privacy-friendly, low-latency inference. It embodies a shift toward on-device or edge AI that reduces reliance on cloud services.
items.summary_zh: Muse Glimmer 是一个为持续本地代理工作流优化的 30B 参数模型，支持持续自我驱动的代理并具备隐私友好、低延迟的推理能力。这反映了在本地或边缘部署 AI、减少对云端依赖的趋势。

items.title_en: GLM-5.3: Frontier coding with emergent cyber capabilities
items.title_zh: GLM-5.3：具备涌现性网络能力的前沿编码
items.summary_en: GLM-5.3 expands the frontier of AI-assisted coding by showcasing emergent cyber capabilities that go beyond standard copilots. It hints at advanced code generation, reasoning, and integration skills that could reshape developer workflows and security tooling.
items.summary_zh: GLM-5.3 展示了超越常规编码助手的涌现性网络能力，推动代码生成、推理与系统集成等方面的进步。此举可能重新定义开发者工作流以及相关的安全工具链。

items.title_en: France to ban unsolicited telemarketing calls
items.title_zh: 法国将全面禁止未经同意的电话推销
items.summary_en: France plans to ban unsolicited telemarketing calls starting August 11, tightening consumer protection. The policy could reshape how marketers reach customers, boosting opt-in channels and call-blocking solutions.
items.summary_zh: 法国将于11日起全面禁止未经请求的电话推销，强化对消费者隐私的保护。该举措可能促使企业转向获同意的联系渠道，并影响营销行业的电话营销策略。

items.title_en: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813
items.title_zh: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813
items.summary_en: DeepSeek releases V4 Pro 0813, a major update that enhances on-device AI performance and search speed. The release focuses on faster indexing, improved privacy controls, and enterprise-friendly features for large-scale data workflows.
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek 发布 V4 Pro 0813，显著提升本地 AI 性能与检索速度，强调更快的索引与更强的隐私控制，并为大规模数据工作流提供企业级特性。

items.title_en: AI is removing the middle class of software engineering?
items.title_zh: AI 正在吞并软件工程的中产阶层
items.summary_en: A viewpoint argues that AI is eroding the middle tier of software engineering by automating routine tasks and raising productivity. It questions career ladders and suggests that engineers must adapt by focusing on higher-level design, system architecture, and AI-augmented workflows.
items.summary_zh: 观点认为 AI 正通过自动化日常任务和提高生产率，削弱软件工程的中层岗位。文章讨论职业晋升路径的变化，建议工程师在高层设计、系统架构以及与 AI 协作的工作流中寻找新机会。

items.title_en: Gemini 3.7 Flash
items.title_zh: Gemini 3.7 快闪版
items.summary_en: Gemini 3.7 Flash extends the Gemini line with a lighter, faster variant optimized for low latency and smaller memory usage. It underscores Google’s ongoing push to edge-ready AI and developer-friendly tooling for large models.
items.summary_zh: Gemini 3.7 快闪版在保持核心能力的同时，提供更轻量、低延迟的推理性能，降低内存占用，便于边缘部署。此举显示谷歌在大模型的边缘化与开发者工具方面的持续推进。

items.title_en: As AI eats the web, the internet’s collective memory is disappearing
items.title_zh: 随着 AI 吃掉网络，互联网的集体记忆正在消失
items.summary_en: As AI consumes more of the web, the internet’s collective memory is thinning. The piece argues that pervasive AI crawling and caching threaten provenance and long-term memory, complicating future search and verification. It calls for durable archiving and mindful data sourcing.
items.summary_zh: 随着 AI 越学越多地抓取网络，互联网的集体记忆正在变薄。文章指出 AI 抓取与缓存的长期可追溯性下降，影响可验证的知识来源。呼吁加强长期存档和负责任的数据获取。

items.title_en: Why does Opus 5 feel worse to work with?
items.title_zh: 为什么 Opus 5 的使用感更差？
items.summary_en: An analysis argues that Opus 5 feels worse to work with due to UX and workflow frictions common in enterprise software. It points to inconsistent interfaces, onboarding friction, and brittle customization that hamper daily productivity, despite feature-rich capabilities.
items.summary_zh: 对 Opus 5 的工作体验为何较差进行了分析，指向用户体验不一致、工作流阻塞和隐藏的复杂性等问题，影响日常生产力。该案例也折射出企业级软件在可用性方面的不足，即便功能强大也难以落地。

items.title_en: Every Fucking Website (2020)
items.title_zh: 《Every Fucking Website》（2020）
items.summary_en: Every Fucking Website is a 2020 project that curates a vast directory of sites, reflecting the sheer scale of the web. It serves as a provocative reference for web exploration and raises questions about discoverability in a trillion-page ecosystem.
items.summary_zh: 《Every Fucking Website》是 2020 年的一个汇集大量网站的项目，体现了网络的庞大规模。它为网络探索提供一种挑衅性的参照，也引发了在海量站点中如何发现内容的思考。

items.title_en: How I use LLMs to learn complex topics
items.title_zh: 我如何用大语言模型学习复杂主题
items.summary_en: I use a staged approach to learning with LLMs: map an outline with the model, generate concise explanations, then test understanding with targeted prompts. This turns the model into a structured tutor that surfaces gaps and helps build solid mental models.
items.summary_zh: 将学习分成阶段使用模型：用它勾勒大纲、生成简明解释、再通过有针对性的提问检验理解。把模型当作高效的学习辅导工具，帮助建立稳固的认知模型并暴露薄弱点。

items.title_en: DeepSeek Harness developer preview
items.title_zh: DeepSeek Harness 框架
items.summary_en: DeepSeek Harness appears to be a framework around DeepSeek AI to run experiments and benchmark performance. It could help teams standardize evaluation, compare model behavior, and improve reproducibility in AI workflows. This development comes at a time when measurable benchmarks are increasingly important for agent-powered systems.
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek Harness 似乎是围绕 DeepSeek AI 的一个用于实验运行与性能基准的框架。它有助于团队标准化评估、对比模型行为，并提升 AI 工作流的可重复性。随着对代理系统的基准衡量需求提升，这类工具的重要性也在上升。

items.title_en: Qwen3.8-2.4T
items.title_zh: Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B 模型
items.summary_en: Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B is a large language model configured for 2.4 trillion parameters, optimized for inference on A95B hardware. The release underscores ongoing scaling and hardware-specific optimizations in modern LLMs.
items.summary_zh: Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B 是一个 2.4 万亿参数的语言模型，针对 A95B 硬件进行推理优化，凸显了当下大模型的规模化与硬件定制优化。

items.title_en: Accelerating GPT-5.6 Sol Ultrafast
items.title_zh: 加速 GPT-5.6 的 Sol Ultrafast
items.summary_en: Cerebras details substantial speedups for GPT-5.6 on its Sol Ultrafast platform, combining specialized hardware with software optimizations to accelerate inference. The result underscores how hardware-software co-design can dramatically shrink response times for cutting-edge LLMs.
items.summary_zh: Cerebras 在 Sol Ultrafast 平台上为 GPT‑5.6 提供显著加速，结合定制硬件与软件优化以缩短推理时间。硬件与软件的协同设计再次推动下一代大模型的实用性。

items.title_en: Spaghettifying DRAM
items.title_zh: 将 DRAM 拆解为意面状结构
items.summary_en: Spaghettifying DRAM examines how unusual or chaotic memory layouts can affect latency, bandwidth, and reliability. The discussion highlights the ongoing tension between memory hardware complexity and software efficiency, suggesting approaches for hardware-aware optimization.
items.summary_zh: Spaghettifying DRAM 探讨了非传统、混乱的内存布局如何影响延迟、带宽与可靠性。该讨论凸显了内存硬件复杂性与软件效率之间的矛盾，并提出面向硬件的优化思路。

items.title_en: Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs
items.title_zh: 从专有大语言模型 API 窃取推理痕迹
items.summary_en: Researchers demonstrate that proprietary LLM APIs can leak traces of reasoning, exposing intermediate prompts and steps. This raises privacy and security concerns about using hosted models and underscores the need for defenses against leakage.
items.summary_zh: 研究者展示了专有大语言模型 API 可能泄露推理痕迹，暴露中间提示和推理步骤。这对使用托管模型的隐私与安全构成挑战，凸显防止信息泄露的必要性。

items.title_en: Delta
items.title_zh: Delta
items.summary_en: Delta introduces a new concept or product in the project's lineup, signaling a potential shift in how it handles data or workflows. The announcement invites readers to anticipate more details on capabilities, integrations, and use cases.
items.summary_zh: Delta 引入了该项目的新概念/产品，可能改变数据处理或工作流方式。公告预计将提供更多关于功能、集成与应用场景的细节。

items.title_en: Docker Sandboxes – Disposable, isolated sandboxes for AI agents
items.title_zh: Docker 沙盒：面向 AI 代理的一次性隔离沙箱
items.summary_en: Docker Sandboxes provide disposable, isolated environments for running AI agents, enabling safer experimentation and reproducibility. They offer controlled dependencies and snapshot-like configurations to prevent cross-agent interference. This helps teams prototype AI tasks without risking the host system.
items.summary_zh: Docker Sandboxes 提供一次性、隔离的运行环境，专为 AI 代理设计，降低实验风险并提高可重复性。通过可控依赖和快照式配置，开发者可以在不影响宿主系统的情况下安全试验复杂的 AI 任务。

items.title_en: Windows 11's built-in Weather app wastes more than 1 GB of RAM
items.title_zh: Windows 11 内置天气应用耗费超过 1GB RAM
items.summary_en: A review finds the built-in Weather app consumes over a gigabyte of RAM, highlighting how preinstalled apps can bloat systems and affect performance even on modern hardware.
items.summary_zh: 评测发现 Windows 11 内置天气应用的内存占用超过 1GB，凸显系统自带应用的资源占用及对性能的潜在影响。

items.title_en: The UK's war on anonymity has come to America
items.title_zh: 英国对匿名性的打压蔓延至美国
items.summary_en: A UK-style push to curb online anonymity is gaining traction in the US, with lawmakers favoring identity verification and traceability. The move signals a broader shift toward user accountability that could reshape platform moderation, data sharing, and civil liberties. For technologists, the takeaway is that privacy-centered design may need stronger defaults and clearer opt-outs.
items.summary_zh: 英国对匿名性的打压正在美国获得关注，立法者日益支持身份核验和可追溯性。此举预示着向用户问责的全球性潮流，可能影响平台治理、数据共享和公民自由。对技术人来说，隐私友好设计需要更强的默认保护与清晰的选择权。

items.title_en: Compression is prediction
items.title_zh: 压缩即预测
items.summary_en: Data compression is fundamentally about predicting the next symbol; improving a compressor equates to a better predictor.
items.summary_zh: 数据压缩本质上是对下一个符号的预测；提升压缩效果等同于改进预测能力。这一观点对机器学习、数据存储与推理具有实际启示，适用于希望把压缩思路融入模型设计的开发者。

items.title_en: Mark Zuckerberg attacks 'closed' AI rivals as Meta returns to open models
items.title_zh: 扎克伯格抨击封闭 AI 对手，Meta 重回开放模型
items.summary_en: Mark Zuckerberg frames Meta’s pivot toward open-weight AI models as a stance against closed rivals, signaling a push for open standards and modular AI. The move underscores the industry tension between proprietary systems and open collaboration.
items.summary_zh: 马克·扎克伯格将 Meta 的策略定位为对抗封闭式 AI 竞争对手，推动采用开放权重模型。此举体现了对开放标准与模块化 AI 的重视，以及行业在开放与封闭之间的博弈。

items.title_en: Grok 4.6
items.title_zh: Grok 4.6
items.summary_en: Grok 4.6 updates the AI assistant with refinements to conversational ability, integration options, and developer-facing tooling. The release highlights ongoing efforts to evolve AI assistants into more capable, context-aware productivity partners.
items.summary_zh: Grok 4.6 对AI助手进行了若干改进，提升对话能力并扩展集成与开发工具。此次发布凸显了让AI助手成为更具情境感知的高效生产力伙伴的持续努力。

items.title_en: License plate reader searches should require a warrant
items.title_zh: 车牌识别搜索应当获得授权才可进行
items.summary_en: Policy arguments are made for requiring warrants to search license plate data collected by LPR systems. It argues targeted, lawfully justified access over generic bulk surveillance.
items.summary_zh: 提出在使用车牌识别（LPR）系统检索数据时应当获得搜查令的政策主张。文章强调公民自由与滥用风险、数据保留与共享的隐私边界，以及应优先实现有针对性且合法授权的访问，而非大规模监控。

items.title_en: Tl;dv: Over 180k meetings left wide open
items.title_zh: Tl;dv：超过18万次会议被暴露
items.summary_en: Tl;dv reveals that over 180,000 meetings were left exposed due to misconfigured access controls, raising concerns about the privacy of meeting transcripts.
items.summary_zh: Tl;dv 指出有超过 18 万场会议因访问控制配置不当而暴露，凸显会议记录隐私的潜在风险。

items.title_en: uBlock Origin Is Giving Up the Fight to Keep Ads Off Facebook
items.title_zh: uBlock Origin 放弃对 Facebook 广告的拦截
items.summary_en: uBlock Origin reportedly stops fighting Facebook ads as Facebook arms itself with anti-adblock techniques. The move shifts the burden to site owners and raises questions about the future of comprehensive ad blocking on social networks.
items.summary_zh: 称为 Facebook 引入对抗广告拦截措施后，uBlock Origin 不再继续拦截 Facebook 广告。此举将拦截责任转向站点所有者，并引发对社交平台上全面广告屏蔽未来的讨论。

items.title_en: Mea Culpa – Dark Hours
items.title_zh: 致歉信：黑暗时刻
items.summary_en: An intimate, candid mea culpa written during a dark chapter. It acknowledges mistakes and their consequences, then outlines concrete changes the author intends to make. The post emphasizes accountability and learning from hardship rather than excuses.
items.summary_zh: 这是一篇在艰难时期写就的坦诚自我批评。文中承认了错误及其后果，并提出今后将采取的具体改进措施，强调对所发生事件的负责与从中学习的重要性。

items.title_en: Asus Bike Booster
items.title_zh: 华硕自行车智能助力器
items.summary_en: Asus introduces Oxiis, an intelligent bike booster that attaches to a regular bicycle to provide adaptive pedal-assist and telemetry. Through smart power modulation and app integration, it aims to smooth both commuting and leisure rides.
items.summary_zh: 华硕推出 Oxiis 自行车智能助力器，安装在普通自行车上即可提供自适应踏板助力并带有数据遥测。通过智能调节动力并与应用联动，提升通勤和休闲骑行的平顺性。

items.title_en: AI isn’t outthinking mathematicians, it’s out-remembering them
items.title_zh: AI 不是在超越数学家，而是在超越他们的记忆力
items.summary_en: The argument is that AI's edge lies in memorization and recall of mathematical facts, databases, and patterns, rather than deep inference. This reframes how we think about AI's role in mathematical discovery and automated reasoning.
items.summary_zh: 观点认为 AI 在数学领域的优势不在于真正“超越”人类的思维，而在于记忆和检索海量的事实、模式与定理。此看法会影响我们对 AI 在数学发现与自动推理中角色的理解。

items.title_en: Claude: System Prompts
items.title_zh: Claude：系统提示
items.summary_en: Claude introduces new capabilities around system prompts, enabling more reliable persona control and safety constraints across conversations. The update emphasizes persistent or configurable prompts to steer model behavior without altering user prompts. This matters for developers building chatbots who require predictable, policy-compliant outputs.
items.summary_zh: Claude 引入了系统提示的新能力，使对话中的角色与行为更加可控和安全。更新强调可配置的系统提示，以在不改动用户提示的前提下引导模型行为。对于需要可预测、合规输出的聊天机器人开发者尤为重要。

items.title_en: England set to be one of the first countries to eliminate hepatitis C
items.title_zh: 英格兰有望成为首批根除丙型肝炎的国家之一
items.summary_en: England is poised to become one of the first countries to eliminate hepatitis C, a milestone driven by broad screening and highly effective antiviral treatments. If achieved, it would validate scalable public-health strategies and could influence targets for other nations facing HCV challenges.
items.summary_zh: 英格兰有望成为首批根除丙型肝炎的国家之一，这一成就依赖广泛筛查和高效抗病毒治疗的组合。若实现，将验证可复制的公共卫生策略，并可能激励其他国家设定相似目标。

items.title_en: Firefox for iOS now has a native adblocker
items.title_zh: iOS 版 Firefox 现已内置原生广告拦截器
items.summary_en: Firefox iOS now ships with a native ad-blocker, improving privacy and page speed by blocking trackers and ads at the browser level. This reduces data usage and helps users bypass some invasive tracking without relying on external extensions.
items.summary_zh: iOS 版 Firefox 增添原生广告拦截功能，通过浏览器层面屏蔽跟踪与广告来提升隐私和页面加载速度。减少数据使用，并在无需外部扩展的情况下改善用户体验。

items.title_en: Show HN: Needle2: 14MB agentic LLM for phones, wearables, smart home and robots
items.title_zh: Needle2：14MB 的设备端智能代理型大模型
items.summary_en: Needle2 is a 14MB agentic LLM designed for phones, wearables, smart home devices, and robots, enabling on-device autonomous agents. It emphasizes privacy, low latency, and edge personalization by running entirely locally. Takeaway: ultra-compact LLMs are unlocking on-device AI for consumer devices.
items.summary_zh: Needle2 是一款面向手机、穿戴设备、智能家居和机器人等设备端运行的14MB代理型大模型，能够在本地实现自主代理。它强调隐私、低延迟和边缘个性化。要点在于超小模型正在推动边缘端 AI 的落地。

items.title_en: OpenAI’s head of ethics leaves less than a year after joining
items.title_zh: OpenAI 道德与伦理主管任职不足一年即离职
items.summary_en: OpenAI's chief ethics officer resigns after less than a year, signaling volatility in steering responsible AI at a leading lab. The move may recalibrate internal governance and external trust around AI safety, policy, and company commitments.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 的伦理负责人在不到一年任期后离职，揭示这家研究机构在负责任 AI 的治理上面临的变动。此举可能影响内部治理与外部对 AI 安全、政策与承诺的信任度。

items.title_en: My server is a phone now
items.title_zh: 我的服务器现在是一部手机
items.summary_en: People are running a server on a smartphone, using the device's always-on nature and affordable hardware to host small services. This underlines edge computing feasibility with commodity devices.
items.summary_zh: 将手机作为服务器的实践，展示用消费级设备承载小型服务的可行性。讨论的权衡包括电池、存储、操作系统支持和网络暴露时的安全性，并给出保持轻量、响应快速的实用建议。这也凸显了边缘计算在普通设备上的潜力。

items.title_en: 2026 Eclipse Webcams
items.title_zh: 2026 年日食网络摄像头
items.summary_en: Coincident with the 2026 eclipse, a collection of live webcams aggregates feeds from observatories and public viewing sites. The roundup helps observers plan timings, compare streams, and prepare for potential bandwidth spikes during peak moments. It’s a handy resource for remote viewers who want real-time visuals without leaving home.
items.summary_zh: 与2026年日食同时上线的多路直播摄像头汇集了来自观测站与公共观测点的画面。该清单帮助观众规划观看时间、比较画面质量，并预测日食高光时段的带宽压力。对于希望在家远程观看的用户，这是一个实用的实时画面资源。

items.title_en: Google is making private AI practical with homomorphic encryption
items.title_zh: 谷歌通过同态加密让私有 AI 变得可实用
items.summary_en: Google is pursuing practical private AI by using homomorphic encryption to run computations on encrypted data. This approach aims to unlock privacy-preserving AI in cloud and on-device settings, though it remains challenging in terms of performance.
items.summary_zh: 谷歌正通过同态加密让隐私保护的 AI 更具可用性，能够在加密数据上执行推理。该思路有望在云端和本地场景中保护用户数据隐私，但在性能方面仍存在挑战。

items.title_en: Semaglutide linked to lower predicted dementia risk
items.title_zh: 西马鲁肽与较低的预测性痴呆风险相关
items.summary_en: New study links semaglutide use to a lower predicted dementia risk, according to risk-model analyses. The finding adds to growing interest in GLP-1 therapies as potential neuroprotectants, but it does not prove causation and leaves room for confounding factors. More research, including clinical dementia outcomes, is needed to confirm any causal effect.
items.summary_zh: 研究显示使用西马鲁肽与预测的痴呆风险下降相关，基于风险评分/生物标志物的分析。该结果提高了对GLP-1治疗在神经保护方面潜力的兴趣，但并不能证明因果关系，需进一步临床结果与机制研究来证实。

items.title_en: Controversial creators are benefiting from monetization programs run by Meta
items.title_zh: 争议性创作者从 Meta 的变现计划获利
items.summary_en: Meta’s monetization programs reportedly pay controversial creators, illustrating the tension between engagement-driven revenue and platform moderation. The arrangement raises questions about incentives, content policy, and where to draw the line between free expression and harmful rhetoric. For builders and platform operators, it underscores the need for transparent rules and auditing of funded content.
items.summary_zh: 据称 Meta 的变现计划向争议性创作者支付报酬，凸显以参与度驱动的创收与平台治理之间的张力。这一安排引发关于激励机制、内容政策以及言论自由与有害言论界限的讨论。对于开发者和平台运营者而言，强调了规则透明和对受资助内容进行审计的重要性。

items.title_en: LinkedIn CringeBot 3000
items.title_zh: 领英尴尬机器人 3000
items.summary_en: A bot named LinkedIn CringeBot 3000 that automates cringe-worthy LinkedIn posts. It serves as a tongue-in-cheek look at social media automation and the allure of flashy, shareable content.
items.summary_zh: 一个自称为 LinkedIn CringeBot 3000 的机器人自动生成让人尴尬的领英帖子，讽刺了社交媒体自动化与追逐高曝光度内容的趋势。

items.title_en: Count Binface receives over a quarter of votes in Clacton by-election
items.title_zh: Count Binface 在 Clacton 补选中获逾四分之一票
items.summary_en: Satirical candidate Count Binface captured more than a quarter of the vote in the Clacton by-election, signaling appetite for anti-establishment voices. The result underscores how protest candidacies can influence local race dynamics.
items.summary_zh: 讽刺性候选人 Count Binface 在 Clacton 补选中获得超过四分之一的选票，显示选民对反建制声音的需求上升。此结果也凸显了抗议候选人如何影响地方选举格局。

items.title_en: Codex in ChatGPT desktop app for Linux is now in preview
items.title_zh: ChatGPT 桌面应用在 Linux 上的 Codex 功能现已进入预览
items.summary_en: Codex is now available in preview inside the Linux version of the ChatGPT desktop app, enabling code-focused assistance in the local environment. This marks a step toward broader Codex integration across desktop platforms and could speed up coding tasks for Linux users. Expect refinements as feedback rolls in during the preview.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 将 Codex 能力带入 Linux 版 ChatGPT 桌面应用，现已进入预览阶段。这让 Linux 用户在桌面环境中体验代码生成功能，标志着桌面端 AI 工具生态的扩展。随着反馈迭代，后续版本将进一步完善。

items.title_en: Going Dark, and the era of law enforcement hacking
items.title_zh: 黑暗来临：执法黑客时代
items.summary_en: As encryption deepens, law enforcement increasingly relies on hacking techniques and sanctioned exploits to access data. The piece argues that the tension between security, privacy, and public safety is intensifying, shaping policy and tool development.
items.summary_zh: 随着端到端加密的普及，执法机构越来越多地转向入侵与滥用漏洞来获取数据。这一趋势将隐私保护、公共安全与政策制定之间的矛盾推向前台，影响工具与法规的发展。

items.title_en: How Claude marks AI-generated content
items.title_zh: Claude 如何标注 AI 生成的内容
items.summary_en: Claude marks AI-generated content with explicit labeling to help users distinguish AI from human authors. This transparency can improve trust and guide moderation in mixed workflows, from content creation to Q&A. The takeaway: look for clear AI-origin cues in Claude outputs.
items.summary_zh: Claude 将 AI 生成的内容以明确标签标注，帮助用户区分人类与机器作者。这种透明度有助于提高信任度，并在混合工作流中为内容审核提供指引。要点是：关注 Claude 输出中的 AI 来源标记。

items.title_en: Gloomberb
items.title_zh: Gloomberb
items.summary_en: Gloomberb signals a project from gloom.sh, but details remain scarce from the title alone. It hints at a new developer tool or service that may be announced or evolved soon.
items.summary_zh: Gloomberb 暗示 gloom.sh 的一个新项目，但从标题本身很难判定具体内容。这可能是一个新的开发工具或服务，预计将很快有更多信息。

items.title_en: Go is an ideal language for AI-assisted software engineering
items.title_zh: 为何 Go 是 AI 辅助软件工程的理想语言
items.summary_en: Go's simplicity, strong concurrency, fast compilation, and reliability make it well-suited for building AI-assisted software tooling, such as code analysis, automations, and integration pipelines. The post argues Go's ecosystem and predictable performance help teams ship AI-powered developer tools with fewer surprises.
items.summary_zh: Go 的简洁性、强大的并发模型、快速编译和稳定性使其非常适合构建 AI 辅助的开发工具，如代码分析、自动化和集成管道。文章认为 Go 的生态和可预测性能有助于团队更稳妥地发布 AI 驱动的开发者工具。

items.title_en: H3-metal – Native MiniMax-H3 inference for Apple Silicon
items.title_zh: H3-metal — 面向 Apple Silicon 的本地 MiniMax-H3 推理
items.summary_en: Native MiniMax-H3 inference runs directly on Apple Silicon via H3-metal. It targets efficient, GPU-accelerated performance for H3 workloads on macOS, reducing cross-OS friction and CPU load. This is relevant for developers who want local, fast inference on Macs.
items.summary_zh: H3-metal 将 MiniMax-H3 的推理本地化到 Apple Silicon，借助 Metal 加速实现更高效的推理。目标是在 macOS 上提供更高效的推理性能，减少跨平台移植的负担和 CPU 开销。对于需要在 Mac 上本地快速处理 H3 相关工作流的开发者尤为有用。

items.title_en: Auto-research with codex: How I achieved a 232x Faster Kernel
items.title_zh: 用 Codex 自动化研究：我如何让内核速度提升 232 倍
items.summary_en: I built an automated research workflow using Codex that accelerates kernel development by 232x. By combining AI-assisted exploration, targeted prompts, and automated code refinement, iteration cycles become dramatically faster for low-level systems work.
items.summary_zh: 我用 Codex 构建了一个自动化研究工作流，将内核开发的迭代速度提升了 232 倍。通过结合 AI 辅助的探索、定向提示和自动代码改进，低级系统开发的迭代周期变得极大地提速。

items.title_en: Understanding is the new bottleneck
items.title_zh: 理解力成为新的瓶颈
items.summary_en: As systems scale, human understanding of data, models, and outcomes becomes the limiting factor. The post argues that tooling for interpretability and governance will determine how fast teams can move from insight to action. Without better explainability, even powerful models can't reliably translate gains into business value.
items.summary_zh: 随着系统规模扩大，对数据、模型和结果的理解成为制约因素。文章认为，提升可解释性和治理能力的工具将决定团队如何快速把洞察转化为行动。若缺乏更好的可解释性，强大的模型也难以可靠地把收益转化为商业价值。

items.title_en: Mojo 1.0
items.title_zh: Mojo 1.0 发布
items.summary_en: Modular announces Mojo 1.0, marking the language's transition from preview to a stable release. Mojo combines Python-like ergonomics with a systems-level performance model, targeting AI/ML workloads and high-throughput apps, with a growing toolchain and libraries.
items.summary_zh: Modular 宣布 Mojo 1.0 正式发布，标志着这门面向 AI/ML 及高吞吐场景的系统编程语言进入稳定阶段。Mojo 将 Python 式易用性与系统级性能结合，伴随逐步完善的工具链与库，旨在提升开发效率与运行效率。

items.title_en: Choose Boring Technology (2015)
items.title_zh: 选择无聊的技术（2015）
items.summary_en: The piece argues for choosing boring technology—reliable, boring options with long lifespans and easier maintenance over flashy, fad-driven stacks. It stresses simplicity, risk reduction, and sustainable engineering choices in real-world deployments.
items.summary_zh: 文章主张在技术选型上优先选择“无聊但可靠”的方案，强调长期维护、稳定性和风险降低。通过对比示例，提出在真实部署中应避免盲目追逐热潮。

items.title_en: Sonic Pi v5
items.title_zh: Sonic Pi 5 发布
items.summary_en: Sonic Pi 5 arrives with enhanced synthesis features and improved live-coding workflows, expanding its educational appeal and performance possibilities. The update strengthens its role as a playful, accessible tool for computer music.
items.summary_zh: Sonic Pi 5 推出，增强了合成能力并改进了现场编程工作流，扩大了在教育与表演方面的应用。此次更新强化了它作为面向大众的轻量级电脑音乐工具的地位。

items.title_en: Super El Niño Keeps Growing as New Forecasts Reach Record Territory Ahead Winter
items.title_zh: 超级厄尔尼诺继续增强，预报达到创纪录水平
items.summary_en: Super El Niño forecasts show growing intensity with record-setting projections ahead of winter, signaling potential heatwaves, droughts, and disruptions across North America and Europe.
items.summary_zh: 预测表明超级厄尔尼诺强度持续增强，冬季前达到创纪录水平，可能带来热浪、干旱及区域性气候干扰，波及北美和欧洲。

items.title_en: Stowaway – Take the window seat on any plane or satellite overhead
items.title_zh: Stowaway：在任意航班抢靠窗座位并查看卫星的工具
items.summary_en: Stowaway is a tool that helps users secure a preferred window seat on flights and provides visibility into satellites overhead, blending travel convenience with space awareness. It demonstrates how real time data and simple UIs can improve trip planning.
items.summary_zh: Stowaway 是一个工具，帮助用户在航班中抢到靠窗座位，同时提供上空卫星轨迹的可视性，展示实时数据与简洁界面的应用潜力。

items.title_en: Deutsche Bank becomes first foreign yuan clearing bank in Europe
items.title_zh: 德意志银行成为欧洲首家清算人民币的境外银行
items.summary_en: Deutsche Bank has become the first foreign bank to clear yuan in Europe, enabling yuan settlement through European clearing networks. The move advances yuan internationalization beyond Asia and could attract more Chinese capital flows and cross-border trade in Europe. It also signals growing competition among European hubs to attract offshore renminbi activity.
items.summary_zh: 德意志银行成为欧洲首家清算人民币的境外银行，开启在欧元区进行人民币清算的服务。这一举动推动人民币在欧洲的国际化进程，或吸引更多人民币资金流向和跨境交易，并影响欧洲清算市场的格局。

items.title_en: Mistral OCR 4.1
items.title_zh: Mistral OCR 4.1
items.summary_en: Mistral OCR 4.1 introduces improvements in optical character recognition, including higher accuracy, better multi-language support, and refined layout analysis. It expands capability for document processing, forms, and scanned media in production pipelines.
items.summary_zh: Mistral OCR 4.1 在识别准确度、多语言支持和版面分析方面有改进，提升了文档处理的效率。对生产线中的表单和扫描件处理具有实用价值。

items.title_en: Mars Bar from 1991 found – and it's 20g bigger than today's
items.title_zh: 1991 年 Mars Bar 的新发现：重量比现今多 20 克
items.summary_en: A 1991 Mars Bar was found to be 20g heavier than the current version, illustrating how product sizes have evolved over time.
items.summary_zh: 发现1991年的 Mars Bar 比现今版本重出 20 克，反映出产品规格随时间的变化。

items.title_en: A 3rd World Embedded Engineer Responds to "RISC-V They Should Have Known Better"
items.title_zh: 来自发展中国家的嵌入式工程师回应：RISC-V 他们本应更懂得
items.summary_en: A developer from a developing region defends RISC-V against claims it is impractical. They emphasize openness, lower hardware costs, and resilient ecosystems for regional players, while acknowledging tooling gaps and maturity issues, arguing the real-world benefits outweigh the drawbacks for cost-sensitive devices.
items.summary_zh: 来自发展中国家的嵌入式工程师为 RISC-V 辩护，强调开放性、较低成本和本地生态对区域硬件制造的帮助，并承认工具链和生态成熟度的不足，但反驳其天生劣势观点。对于需要成本敏感设备的现实场景，RISC-V 的优势在于灵活性和供应链韧性。

items.title_en: Ordinary Abundance
items.title_zh: 日常的丰盈
items.summary_en: A meditation on abundance in tech and life, challenging scarcity mindsets and highlighting ways to build resilient systems, generous collaboration, and sustainable design.
items.summary_zh: 聚焦在技术与生活中的丰富性，挑战匮乏思维，倡导更可持续、容错与协作友好的设计与实现方式。

items.title_en: The other Sean Byrne doesn't exist
items.title_zh: 另一位 Sean Byrne 不存在
items.summary_en: An essay exploring identity and authorial authenticity, using the claim that 'the other Sean Byrne doesn't exist' to probe how online personas are constructed and how readers perceive who writes what.
items.summary_zh: 一篇关于身份与署名真实性的随笔，借“另一位 Sean Byrne 不存在”之论点，考察网络身份的构建与读者如何认定作者。

items.title_en: Nine PBS sues Iron Mountain over blocked access to archival data
items.title_zh: Nine PBS 因被限制访问档案数据而起诉 Iron Mountain
items.summary_en: The broadcaster alleges that Iron Mountain blocked access to archival data, prompting legal action. The case highlights how vendor-controlled archives intersect with public-access requirements and preservation obligations. If the suit succeeds, it could influence data governance policies for libraries, broadcasters, and other institutions.
items.summary_zh: 该机构指控 Iron Mountain 阻断对档案数据的访问，提起诉讼。此案凸显了由厂商控制的档案与公开访问需求及保存义务之间的矛盾。若胜诉，可能影响图书馆、广播机构等组织的数据治理政策。

items.title_en: Taxi drivers rarely die of Alzheimer's
items.title_zh: 出租车司机罹患阿尔茨海默病的风险较低
items.summary_en: A study indicates taxi drivers' rich, complex spatial navigation and mental maps may protect against Alzheimer's, highlighting how environmental cognitive training can influence brain resilience.
items.summary_zh: 研究显示，出租车司机复杂的空间导航和地图记忆可能提升大脑对阿尔茨海默病的抵抗力，强调环境中的认知训练对脑部韧性的潜在影响。

items.title_en: What Happened to HackerOne?
items.title_zh: HackerOne 到底发生了什么？
items.summary_en: HackerOne, once a dominant bug-bounty marketplace, has faced market headwinds and leadership shifts.
items.summary_zh: HackerOne 作为主流的漏洞赏金平台，近来遭遇市场挑战与组织调整。文章聚焦发生了什么变化——客户流失、来自自建计划的竞争、以及安全研究经济学的变化——以及这对漏洞赏金生态的影响。

items.title_en: Everything you do is being recorded
items.title_zh: 你所做的一切都在被记录
items.summary_en: Examines pervasive AI-powered surveillance and data collection in modern life, and discusses countermeasures, privacy preserving techniques, and design considerations for mitigating tracking. The piece warns about the trade-offs between convenience and privacy.
items.summary_zh: 探讨当今生活中被 AI 驱动的广泛监控与数据收集，并讨论应对措施、隐私保护技术，以及降低追踪风险的设计要点。文中强调方便性与隐私之间的权衡。

items.title_en: Seven books I keep close because I love them
items.title_zh: 七本我最珍爱的书
items.summary_en: A personal list of seven cherished books, with notes on why each title resonated and stuck with the reader. The selections reveal what this reader values in literature.
items.summary_zh: 作者列出七本珍爱的书，并简要解释它们为何留存于心。清单透视了他在文学中的偏好与思考方式。

items.title_en: Hello, me. It's been a while
items.title_zh: 你好，我，是我。好久不见。
items.summary_en: Hello, me. It's been a while
items.summary_zh: 这是作者在长期休笔后回归的个人更新。

items.title_en: Research papers using "kidney disappointment" instead of "kidney failure"
items.title_zh: 研究论文把“kidney disappointment”代替“kidney failure”？
items.summary_en: A linguistic note highlights papers using 'kidney disappointment' instead of 'kidney failure', illustrating how terminology can soften or reframing research narratives.
items.summary_zh: 有论文把“kidney disappointment”用于替代“kidney failure”，以缓和叙事语气。该现象反映了语言选择如何影响患者感知与科学传播的方式。

items.title_en: RISC-V: They Should Have Known Better
items.title_zh: RISC‑V：本应更早看清问题
items.summary_en: A provocative take argues the RISC-V ecosystem should have anticipated current challenges, highlighting openness, governance, and ecosystem maturity trade-offs. The piece warns against over-optimism and suggests reforms to sustain momentum against established ISAs.
items.summary_zh: 一篇尖锐观点认为RISC‑V生态系统本应预见到当前挑战，聚焦开放性、治理与生态成熟度之间的取舍。文章警示不过度乐观，并提出改革建议以在与成熟指令集体系的竞争中保持动力。

items.title_en: The hardest working font in Manhattan (2025)
items.title_zh: 曼哈顿最忙碌的字体（2025）
items.summary_en: The hardest working font in Manhattan (2025) examines a font optimized for dense urban signage, readability across distances and lighting, and high-contrast digital displays.
items.summary_zh: 《曼哈顿最忙碌的字体（2025）》聚焦一种为密集城市环境量身打造的字体，强调远近可读性、对比度和昼夜照明下的清晰呈现。文章探讨字体设计如何提升城市信息传达的效率与可访问性。

items.title_en: London Underground begins scanning passengers' faces
items.title_zh: 伦敦地铁开始对乘客进行人脸扫描
items.summary_en: Live facial recognition trials expand in London Underground, raising civil-liberties concerns about surveillance, data privacy, and false positives in real-world transit settings.
items.summary_zh: 伦敦地铁的现场人脸识别试验扩大，引发关于监控、数据隐私和误判等在真实交通场景中的民权与隐私担忧。

items.title_en: AI by Hand
items.title_zh: AI by Hand
items.summary_en: AI by Hand explores human-in-the-loop AI, emphasizing how thoughtful human input can improve model alignment, safety, and practicality. The project highlights an approach where people guide or augment AI rather than replacing them.
items.summary_zh: AI by Hand 探讨人机协作中的 AI，强调通过人为输入改善对齐、安全与实用性。该项目强调以人为主导的 AI 方案，而非单纯的全自动替代。

items.title_en: llama.cpp
items.title_zh: llama.cpp 项目
items.summary_en: llama.cpp is an open-source project that enables running Meta's LLaMA models efficiently on CPU with minimal dependencies. It unlocks offline AI use cases and makes local inference accessible without GPUs, which matters for privacy-focused developers and hobbyists alike. It also broadens access for researchers and small teams.
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp 是一个开源项目，使 LLaMA 模型能够在 CPU 上高效运行，依赖尽量精简。它为离线 AI 场景提供了可行性，便于在没有 GPU 的本地环境中推理，并扩大了研究者与小团队的接触面。

items.title_en: In Australia, a home battery boom has helped cut wholesale power prices
items.title_zh: 澳大利亚家庭电池热潮帮助削减批发电价
items.summary_en: Australia's home battery boom is helping cut wholesale power prices by enabling households to store solar energy and shift demand. The trend underscores how distributed storage can ease grid stress and reshape energy economics.
items.summary_zh: 澳大利亚家庭用电池热潮使家庭能够储存太阳能并错峰用电，从而压低批发电价。分布式储能对缓解电网压力、重塑能源经济具有重要意义。

items.title_en: Nvidia's Risky Business
items.title_zh: 英伟达的高风险商业策略
items.summary_en: Stratechery argues that Nvidia’s aggressive bets on AI compute demand, expanding software ecosystems, and potential regulatory scrutiny are high-stakes moves. The upside is market leadership, but margins could compress if demand softens or competitors erode the moat.
items.summary_zh: Stratechery 指出英伟达在 AI 计算需求、软件生态扩张以及潜在监管压力等方面的高风险布局。若需求减弱或竞争加剧，利润率可能承压；但也有通过成为 AI 基础设施核心而维持领先地位的潜力。

items.title_en: Illinois just passed a law that puts Linux on the hook for age verification
items.title_zh: 伊利诺伊州通过法案，将操作系统纳入年龄验证责任
items.summary_en: Illinois passed a law that makes operating systems bear responsibility for age verification. This raises feasibility, enforcement, and open-source implications for Linux and other platforms as lawmakers seek to curb underage access.
items.summary_zh: 新法案要求操作系统具备并执行对受限内容的年龄验证，间接让 Linux 等操作系统承担相关义务。此举引发关于可行性、执法及对开源生态的影响等担忧。

items.title_en: Grok Bot
items.title_zh: Grok Bot
items.summary_en: Grok Bot is an AI assistant from X.AI designed to handle emails, scheduling, and other productivity tasks with natural language understanding and proactive suggestions.
items.summary_zh: Grok Bot 是 X.AI 推出的 AI 助手，能够通过自然语言理解处理电子邮件、日程等生产力任务，并提供主动建议。

items.title_en: Grok 4.6 scores 61 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
items.title_zh: Grok 4.6 在人工分析智能指数上得到61分
items.summary_en: Grok 4.6 scores 61 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, shedding light on where the model excels at analytical tasks and where it stumbles. The benchmark reveals strengths and limitations in reasoning reliability and error susceptibility, with implications for data-heavy workflows. It also prompts reflection on how well such indexes map to real-world problem solving in AI assistants.
items.summary_zh: Grok 4.6 在人工分析智能指数上得到61分，揭示模型在分析任务中的强项与弱点。基准测试显示推理可靠性与对错误的易感性，为数据密集型工作流提供洞察，也引发关于此类指数与实际问题求解能力之间关系的思考。

items.title_en: RustDesk now supports true unattended remote access on Wayland
items.title_zh: RustDesk 在 Wayland 上实现真实的无监督远程访问
items.summary_en: RustDesk adds true unattended remote access support on Wayland, enabling headless setups and smoother admin tasks on Linux desktops. This strengthens its suitability for remote maintenance while raising typical security considerations.
items.summary_zh: RustDesk 在 Wayland 上增加了真正的无监督远程访问支持，适用于无头/远程运维的 Linux 桌面场景，同时需关注远程访问的安全性与权限控制。

items.title_en: Why tiny JPEGs look different in Chrome
items.title_zh: Chrome 中小尺寸 JPEG 的显示差异原因
items.summary_en: Tiny JPEGs can render differently in Chrome due to the browser's image downscaling and color subsampling behavior. Chrome's decoding and scaling pipeline, along with DPR and subpixel rendering, can yield color shifts or sharpness changes compared with other browsers. Understanding this helps designers make consistent thumbnails and image previews.
items.summary_zh: Chrome 在对小尺寸 JPEG 进行缩放时的解码与渲染策略会导致呈现与其他浏览器略有差异。浏览器的下采样、放大算法以及设备像素比等因素可能带来颜色偏差或清晰度变化。了解原因有助于设计师在缩略图和图片预览时实现更一致的显示。

items.title_en: Abdominal fat predicts heart disease risk better than BMI
items.title_zh: 腹部脂肪比BMI更能预测心血管疾病风险
items.summary_en: New evidence shows abdominal fat is a stronger predictor of heart disease risk than BMI, underscoring the importance of central adiposity measures. The finding could influence screening practices and public health messaging by shifting focus from weight alone to fat distribution. Clinicians may increasingly consider waist circumference or visceral fat assessments in risk estimation.
items.summary_zh: 最新证据表明腹部脂肪对心血管疾病风险的预测力优于BMI，强调了腹部肥胖等中心性脂肪指标的重要性。这一发现可能影响筛查实践与公共健康信息的传播，将重点从体重单一指标转向脂肪分布。临床上可能越来越在风险评估中考虑腰围或内脏脂肪等指标。

items.title_en: Maximizing the value of your Claude Code sessions
items.title_zh: 最大化 Claude Code 会话的价值
items.summary_en: Claude Code sessions can be optimized by structuring prompts, leveraging file uploads, and iterating with targeted queries to improve code generation and debugging quality. Small workflow tweaks yield outsized gains.
items.summary_zh: 通过结构化提示、上传代码文件以及有针对性的迭代查询来优化 Claude Code 会话，可以显著提升代码生成与调试质量，小改动也能带来大收益。

items.title_en: Ask HN: What are you working on? (August 2026)
items.title_zh: Ask HN：你在做什么？（2026年8月）
items.summary_en: A recurring Hacker News thread invites developers to share current projects, challenges, and tech stacks. The August 2026 edition spotlights solo ventures, AI tooling experiments, and infrastructure tinkering, offering a pulse on the edge of indie and startup work.
items.summary_zh: 这是 Hackernews 的常规主题，开发者在帖中描述当前项目、遇到的挑战和技术栈。2026年8月的讨论聚焦个人项目、AI 工具化尝试与基础设施实验，展现独立开发者的工作动向。

items.title_en: Apple Silicon and macOS VMs: Faster LLM Inference with llama.cpp
items.title_zh: Apple Silicon 与 macOS 虚拟机：借助 llama.cpp 实现更快的 LLM 推理
items.summary_en: Apple Silicon machines running macOS VMs can use GPU passthrough to speed up LLM inference with llama.cpp. The setup shows how Macs can squeeze more AI throughput for local or private-cloud workflows, though it comes with VM stability and driver caveats. Practical tips and pitfalls accompany the approach for developers exploring on-device AI.
items.summary_zh: 在 Apple Silicon 的 Mac 上，通过为 macOS 虚拟机启用 GPU 直通，可以用 llama.cpp 加速大语言模型推理。这种方案展示了在 Mac 上提升 AI 处理能力的可行性，便于实现本地化或私有云推理。实施中的现实挑战包括虚拟机稳定性、驱动兼容性以及功耗与散热等问题。

items.title_en: Tell HN: Cloudflare silently injects its analytics when you switch nameservers
items.title_zh: Tell HN: Cloudflare 在切换域名服务器时悄然注入分析代码
items.summary_en: A post alleges Cloudflare injects its analytics code when you switch DNS, enabling traffic telemetry without explicit consent. The finding raises questions about privacy, transparency, and the trade-offs of using a privacy-focused CDN.
items.summary_zh: 有人指称 Cloudflare 在你切换 DNS 时悄然注入分析代码，进行流量遥测而未征得明确同意。这一发现引发对隐私、透明度及使用隐私导向 CDNs 时权衡取舍的讨论。

items.title_en: Working with AI feels more like leadership than coding
items.title_zh: 与 AI 共事更多是领导力，而非编码
items.summary_en: The author argues that AI alters day-to-day work from coding tasks to orchestration, decision making, and people leadership. Effective collaboration with AI requires new skills in alignment, governance, and cross-disciplinary communication.
items.summary_zh: 作者认为与 AI 的日常工作从编码转向协作、决策与人际领导。要高效与 AI 合作，需要在对齐、治理与跨学科沟通等方面具备新技能。

items.title_en: Show HN: Woxi - Open-source Mathematica / Wolfram Language reimplementation
items.title_zh: Show HN：Woxi：开源的 Mathematica / Wolfram Language 重实现
items.summary_en: Woxi offers an open-source reimplementation of Mathematica/Wolfram Language aimed at researchers and educators who want an accessible, libre alternative. It provides a scripting and computation environment that mimics core Wolfram features and symbolic computation. The project could lower barriers for experimentation and education in computational math.
items.summary_zh: Woxi 提供开源实现，旨在为研究者与教育者提供一个可访问的替代 Mathematica/Wolfram Language 的计算环境，模仿核心符号计算与脚本能力。该项目可能降低在计算性数学教育和研究中的门槛，并扩展自由工具的使用场景。

items.title_en: Someone is running mass vulnerability scans, spoofing AI bots like ClaudeBot
items.title_zh: 有人在进行大规模漏洞扫描，伪装成 ClaudeBot 等 AI 机器人
items.summary_en: Threat researchers report mass vulnerability scanning that spoofs AI bots like ClaudeBot to evade detection. The practice complicates attribution, strains rate limits, and can hamper legitimate AI services that rely on bot-like traffic patterns. For defenders, it underscores the need for robust fingerprinting and anomaly detection.
items.summary_zh: 安全研究者发现有人在进行大规模漏洞扫描，并伪装成像 ClaudeBot 这样的 AI 机器人以逃避检测。此举增加了追责难度，可能挤占限流资源，并干扰依赖机器人流量模式的服务。对防御方而言，这凸显了加强指纹识别和异常流量检测的必要性。

items.title_en: Tim King, AmigaDOS developer, has died
items.title_zh: AmigaDOS 开发者 Tim King 去世
items.summary_en: Tim King, a pivotal figure behind AmigaDOS, has passed away. His work helped shape retro computing and inspired generations of hobbyists and OS enthusiasts.
items.summary_zh: AmigaDOS 关键人物 Tim King 去世；他的工作塑造了复古计算，并启发了众多爱好者与操作系统爱好者。

items.title_en: Qwen3.8-27B
items.title_zh: Qwen3.8-27B 模型
items.summary_en: Qwen 3.8-27B is released as a 27B parameter model, continuing the Qwen family’s growth for multilingual tasks. It illustrates the rapid expansion of mid-sized LLMs tailored for practical deployment.
items.summary_zh: Qwen 3.8-27B 作为 27B 参数规模的新版本，延续 Qwen 家族在多语言任务上的能力。此举体现了中等规模大模型在实际落地中的快速扩展。

items.title_en: Chicken Scheme 6.0
items.title_zh: Chicken Scheme 6.0 发布
items.summary_en: Chicken Scheme 6.0 ships with modernization and expansion of libraries, focusing on better runtime performance and compatibility with existing Scheme ecosystems. The release signals continued vitality of lightweight Scheme compilers for embedding and scripting.
items.summary_zh: Chicken Scheme 6.0 发布，带来库的扩展、运行时性能改进和对现有 Scheme 生态的更好兼容。此举显示了轻量级 Scheme 编译器在嵌入和脚本场景中的持续活力。

items.title_en: Silicon Valley misreads science fiction and undermines democracy
items.title_zh: 硅谷对科幻的误读正在削弱民主
items.summary_en: Jill Lepore argues Silicon Valley leaders are bad readers who misunderstand science fiction and its implications for democracy. The piece argues that tech culture's techno-optimism and underappreciation of history undermine policy and accountability. For technologists and policymakers, it underscores the need for literary and historical literacy in tech leadership.
items.summary_zh: 吉尔·勒波尔指出硅谷领导者对科幻的解读严重偏离现实，忽视科幻对民主的潜在影响。文章批评科技文化的技术至上与历史认知不足可能削弱政策与问责。对技术人员与决策者而言，这强调提升文学与历史素养的重要性。

items.title_en: Show HN: Scroll through all 43252003274489856000 Rubik's Cube states
items.summary_en: A Show HN demonstrates a user interface that scrolls through the entire state space of a Rubik's Cube, totaling over 43 quintillion configurations. It showcases how large combinatorial spaces can be made approachable through clever visualization and streaming data.
items.summary_zh: 一个 Show HN 展示了一个界面，能够滚动浏览魔方全部状态，总数超过 43,252,003,274,489,856,000 种配置。通过巧妙的可视化和分段加载，该项目让庞大组合空间变得更易理解。

items.title_en: Cool URIs Don't Change (1998)
items.title_zh: 稳定的 URI 不会改变（1998）
items.summary_en: A foundational memo urging that URIs be stable, permanent identifiers for resources. It argues against design patterns that rely on mutable URLs, explaining how changing links breaks navigation, indexing, and caching—lessons that still influence modern web architecture.
items.summary_zh: 这份1998年的基石性备忘录强调 URI 应保持稳定、永久指向资源，反对依赖可变链接的设计模式。链接变动会破坏导航、搜索索引与缓存，这些经验至今仍深刻影响现代 Web 架构。

items.title_en: At-home test for infected ticks could improve Lyme Disease diagnosis
items.title_zh: 首个在家检测感染蜱虫的测试或提升莱姆病诊断
items.summary_en: The first at-home test to identify infected ticks could shift Lyme disease diagnosis toward earlier, more accurate triage. If validated, it enables people to assess exposure risk before symptoms appear, though accuracy and interpretation will be key.
items.summary_zh: 首个在家检测感染蜱虫的测试可能将莱姆病诊断转向更早且更精确的分诊。若经验证，该测试将使人们在出现症状前就能评估暴露风险，但准确性和解读方式将成为关键。

items.title_en: Software Engineering fundamentals matter more
items.title_zh: 软件工程基础现在比以往任何时候都重要
items.summary_en: Software engineering fundamentals matter more than ever as teams navigate AI tooling, distributed work, and complex codebases. The post argues for preserving core practices like clean design, testing, and robust versioning.
items.summary_zh: 软件工程的基础原理在 AI、分布式工作与复杂代码库的时代显得更加重要，文章呼吁坚持测试、设计与版本管理等核心实践。

items.title_en: Auto mode is now the default in Claude Code
items.title_zh: Claude Code 的自动模式现已设为默认
items.summary_en: Claude Code now defaults to auto mode, speeding up coding workflows by automatically drafting suggestions and actions. Users can still adjust behavior, but the change reduces friction for everyday tasks and highlights how proactive AI assistants are becoming. This shift may influence how teams design coding sessions and reviews.
items.summary_zh: Claude Code 的自动模式现已设为默认，从而加速编码工作流，自动给出建议与动作。用户仍可调整设置，但这一改动降低了日常任务的门槛，凸显了 AI 助手日益主动的趋势，并可能影响团队的编码工作流程与评审方式。

items.title_en: Squeak 6.1
items.title_zh: Squeak 6.1 发布
items.summary_en: Squeak 6.1 introduces performance improvements and new tooling for the Smalltalk ecosystem, with better compatibility for education and development.
items.summary_zh: Squeak 6.1 带来性能提升与新工具，提升 Smalltalk 生态在教育与开发中的兼容性。

items.title_en: Models Are Getting Dumber on Purpose
items.title_zh: 模型在有意降级以提升安全性
items.summary_en: The post argues that AI models are getting intentionally dumber to improve safety, control, or cost, rather than simply getting smarter from more data. It discusses the tension between capability and governance, and what that means for developers relying on ever more powerful systems.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为，AI 模型正被有意降级，以提高安全性、可控性以及成本效益，而不仅仅是靠更多数据来提升能力。讨论了能力与治理之间的张力，以及开发者在日益强大的系统面前所面临的取舍。

items.title_en: Tom Stanton's supersonic trebuchet breaks sound barrier with gravity alone
items.title_zh: 汤姆·斯坦顿的超音速投石机仅靠重力突破声障
items.summary_en: Tom Stanton's gravity-powered trebuchet achieves supersonic release speeds, beating the sound barrier using only gravitational potential energy. It's a clever demonstration of physics and energy transfer at macro scales.
items.summary_zh: 汤姆·斯坦顿的重力驱动投石机在仅靠重力势能的情况下实现超音速发射，突破音速。这个演示展示了宏观尺度的能量储存与动量传递的物理原理。

items.title_en: Mushroom behind 'tiny people' hallucinations identified
items.title_zh: 识别出引发小人幻觉的蘑菇
items.summary_en: Researchers have identified the mushroom species behind reports of tiny people hallucinations during certain psychedelic experiences. The finding sheds light on how specific compounds reshape visual perception, with implications for safety, medical research, and foragers' awareness.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员已确定在某些迷幻体验中引发小人幻觉的蘑菇种类。该发现揭示了特定成分如何改变视觉感知，为安全使用、药物研究和野外采集者的认知提高了理解。

items.title_en: Principia Mathematica is modern and insightful
items.title_zh: 《Principia Mathematica》现代且富有洞见
items.summary_en: Principia Mathematica laid the rigorous groundwork for modern logic and foundational mathematics. Its ideas underpin contemporary automated reasoning, formal verification, and type systems in programming languages, and its layered approach to axioms and inference still informs how we build reliable software today.
items.summary_zh: 《Principia Mathematica》奠定了现代逻辑与基础数学的坚实框架，其内容在自动推理、形式化验证和编程语言的类型系统中仍具影响力。其对公理与推理的层次化思路，至今为构建可靠软件提供了宝贵的借鉴。

items.title_en: Donkey.bas is 45 Years Old – 131 line of Glory
items.title_zh: Donkey.bas 已有 45 年——131 行的荣耀
items.summary_en: Donkey.bas turns 45, celebrated as a 131-line BASIC game that exemplifies minimalism and longevity in software. The post reflects on how tiny programs can still inspire modern retro or minimalist game design and learning.
items.summary_zh: Donkey.bas 的 45 年纪念聚焦于这段131行的 BASIC 小程序如何成为极简主义与持续影响力的典范。它揭示微小代码也能激发现代创作与学习灵感。

items.title_en: Asynchronous I/O in DuckDB: Work, Thread, Work
items.title_zh: DuckDB 的异步 I/O：工作、线程、工作
items.summary_en: DuckDB adds asynchronous I/O, enabling query processing to overlap with I/O operations via background workers. This reduces stalls on large scans and improves throughput for analytics workloads.
items.summary_zh: DuckDB 引入异步 I/O，使查询处理能与磁盘操作并行执行，借助后台工作线程降低等待，提高对大规模分析的吞吐量。

items.title_en: WorldClaw Agentic 3D open-world generation at scale
items.title_zh: WorldClaw Agentic：大规模3D开放世界生成
items.summary_en: WorldClaw Agentic introduces scalable 3D open-world generation powered by AI agents. It demonstrates a pipeline for large-scale content creation, streaming, and dynamic world building suitable for games, simulations, or metaverse platforms; the key takeaway is the role of agentic AI in automating complex, scalable environments.
items.summary_zh: WorldClaw Agentic 展示了利用 AI 代理实现的大规模3D开放世界生成。该方案面向游戏、仿真和元宇宙等对海量内容需求场景，强调了自动化、可扩展的世界构建与内容流的潜在价值。

items.title_en: Learning more about Claude's mathematical capabilities
items.title_zh: 进一步了解 Claude 的数学能力
items.summary_en: Anthropic researchers evaluate Claude's mathematical reasoning, testing symbolic tasks and number theory to gauge its capabilities and limitations. The findings show clear progress in some areas but also persistent gaps in formal proofs and complex computations.
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 的研究团队评估 Claude 的数学推理能力，测试符号推理与数论等任务，旨在了解其能力边界。结果显示在某些领域取得明显进步，但在证明与复杂计算方面仍存在不足。

items.title_en: Show HN: iPhone app takes simultaneous images from 2 lenses, fuses into 1 photo
items.title_zh: Show HN：iPhone 应用实现两镜头同时拍摄并融合成一张照片
items.summary_en: A mobile app captures frames from both iPhone lenses in parallel and fuses them into a single image. This approach demonstrates how dual-camera data can be combined to improve resolution, detail, or dynamic range, pushing the capabilities of mobile photography. It hints at broader potential for real-time computational photography on consumer devices.
items.summary_zh: 一款移动应用并行从两枚 iPhone 镜头获取帧并融合成一张高质量照片。通过融合双镜头数据来提升分辨率、细节和动态范围，展示了计算摄影在手机上的潜力。这类技术为在日常设备上实现更强大摄影能力提供了可行路径。

items.title_en: A spectre is haunting Unicode
items.title_zh: Unicode 遇到幽灵字符
items.summary_en: Unicode’s complexity allows visually similar or confusable characters to cause spoofing and security risks. The piece cites concrete examples and argues for stricter normalization and rendering controls to reduce abuse in critical contexts.
items.summary_zh: Unicode 的复杂性使视觉上相似或易混淆的字符可能被利用进行伪装，带来安全风险。文中给出具体示例，并主张在规范化和渲染控制方面加强措施，以在关键场景中降低滥用。

items.title_en: Woman pulled over twice after Flock-linked software connected her to homicide
items.title_zh: Flock 系统误将她与凶杀案相关联，导致她两次被拦下
items.summary_en: A woman says a Flock surveillance alert linked her to a homicide, leading to two police stops. The incident highlights the risk of misidentification in automated policing tools and the real-world consequences for civilians.
items.summary_zh: 一名女性称，Flock 监控系统的警报将她与一起凶杀案相关联，导致她两次被警方拦下。这一事件凸显了自动化警务工具在误识别方面的风险，以及对平民造成的现实后果。

items.title_en: More than 10 firms pay up to $100k a month for access to Truth Social posts
items.title_zh: 超过十家公司每月最高支付十万美元获取 Truth Social 帖子访问权限
items.summary_en: More than ten firms pay up to $100,000 a month for access to Truth Social posts to monitor sentiment and trends. This reveals opaque data-access practices on fringe networks and raises privacy and ethics questions for brands and researchers.
items.summary_zh: 超过十家企业为获取 Truth Social 帖子访问权，月费高达十万美元，以监控情感与趋势。这一做法揭示了小众网络的数据访问模式的隐蔽性，并对品牌与研究机构的隐私与伦理提出质疑。

items.title_en: US conducted mass spying campaign against leftwing and anti-ICE protesters
items.title_zh: 美国对左翼团体与反移民执法抗议者进行大规模监控
items.summary_en: New reporting shows the US government conducted mass surveillance targeting left-wing groups and anti-ICE protesters. The findings shed light on the scale of domestic intelligence collection and raise questions about civil liberties, oversight, and data-use practices in security operations.
items.summary_zh: 报道显示美国政府对左翼团体和反移民执法（ICE）抗议者进行了大规模监控。相关发现揭示国内情报机构利用数字工具监控政治异议的规模，凸显公民自由、监督问责与数据使用监管的重要议题。

items.title_en: Nvidia Nemotron 3.5 Lightning and NeMo Switchyard
items.title_zh: 英伟达 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 与 NeMo Switchyard
items.summary_en: Nvidia expands Nemotron 3.5 with Lightning and introduces NeMo Switchyard to improve deployment and orchestration for AI workloads across DGX clusters. The update emphasizes streamlined model serving, unified management, and higher throughput for large-scale inference. For enterprises building AI-powered apps, it suggests a more integrated, scalable path from model development to production.
items.summary_zh: 英伟达推出 Nemotron 3.5 的 Lightning 版本并引入 NeMo Switchyard，优化在 DGX 集群上的 AI 部署与编排。升级聚焦统一管理、提升推理吞吐，帮助企业将模型从开发到生产的落地更高效。

items.title_en: What sort of maths are LLMs good at?
items.title_zh: 大型语言模型擅长哪些数学领域？
items.summary_en: LLMs show proficiency in certain math domains, especially structured, rule-based tasks, but struggle with novel proofs and deep abstraction. The discussion maps which areas align with training data and inference patterns, and why prompting and tooling matter for boosting performance. It helps readers decide when to rely on LLMs for math versus formal proof systems.
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型在某些数学领域表现出色，尤其是结构化、规则性强的任务，但在新颖证明和深层抽象方面存在短板。讨论梳理了哪些数学领域与训练数据及推理模式更契合，以及为何通过提示与工具能提升表现。帮助读者判断在数学任务中应如何在依赖 LLM 与使用正式证明系统之间取舍。

items.title_en: Cultivating a state of mind where new ideas are born (2023)
items.title_zh: 孕育新想法的心态（2023）
items.summary_en: A thoughtful exploration of practices that foster creative thinking and the birth of new ideas, with practical suggestions learned in 2023.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章回顾如何塑造一种有利于新想法诞生的心态，给出在2023年尝试过的做法和建议，关注专注、环境与思维习惯的培养。

items.title_en: Single log line is 49KB+ (ext4) / 110KB+ (btrfs) of systemd-journald disk writes
items.title_zh: systemd 日志单行在 ext4/btrfs 下的极大写入
items.summary_en: Notes that a single systemd-journald log line can trigger very large disk writes on ext4 and btrfs. This has implications for log throughput, storage planning, and how journaling backends should handle extreme entries.
items.summary_zh: 指出 systemd-journald 的单条日志行在 ext4 下会触发极大的磁盘写入，在 btrfs 下也如此。这对日志吞吐、存储规划以及日志后端处理极端日志条目提出了考虑。

items.title_en: What's the best programming language for coding agents?
items.title_zh: 哪种编程语言最适合为智能代理编码？
items.summary_en: The piece surveys languages and paradigms suited for coding autonomous agents, weighing factors like state management, concurrency, and safety of agent interactions.
items.summary_zh: 本文评估用于编写自治代理的编程语言，比较状态管理、并发、代理交互的安全性等因素。

items.title_en: HTML over WebSockets: real-time SPAs with barely any JavaScript
items.title_zh: 通过 WebSockets 的 HTML：几乎不需要 JavaScript 的实时单页应用
items.summary_en: A blog demonstrates real-time SPAs by delivering HTML over WebSockets, reducing client-side JS and bundle sizes. The approach offers a lightweight alternative when interactivity can be server-driven.
items.summary_zh: 一篇博文展示通过 WebSockets 传送 HTML 来实现实时 SPAs，显著减少客户端 JavaScript 与包体大小，适用于服务器驱动的轻量化场景。

items.title_en: Shade Map
items.title_zh: Shade Map 阴影地图
items.summary_en: Shade Map provides a focused tool for visualizing shading data, whether for photography, architecture, or solar planning. The app emphasizes real-time or asset-based shading calculations and exportable charts.
items.summary_zh: Shade Map 提供一个专注于可视化遮阴数据的工具，适用于摄影、建筑或太阳能规划等场景。该应用强调实时或基于资源的遮阴计算和可导出的图表。

items.title_en: Stop Killing Games: It's time to sue Sony, join us
items.title_zh: 停止扼杀游戏：现在就应该起诉索尼，加入我们
items.summary_en: A consumer-advocacy campaign calls for legal action against Sony over practices they claim harm players or developers. The push aims to catalyze a class-action or collective suit to press for changes.
items.summary_zh: 一个消费者倡议团体呼吁就索尼的游戏相关商业行为提起诉讼，声称这些做法损害玩家与开发者权益。该行动主张通过集体诉讼等方式迫使公司改变策略。

items.title_en: NP-overrated
items.title_zh: NP-被高估了吗
items.summary_en: A provocative take arguing that the significance of NP problems is overstated in practical computing, urging researchers to focus on real-world constraints.
items.summary_zh: 一个挑衅性的观点，认为在实际计算中 NP 问题的重要性被高估，呼吁把研究焦点放在真实世界的约束上。

items.title_en: DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing update
items.title_zh: DeepSeek 峰值与非峰值定价更新
items.summary_en: DeepSeek updates its peak vs. off-peak pricing, signaling new usage-cost signals for customers and potential shifts in how indexing or API usage is billed.
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek 发布峰值与非峰值定价更新，带来新的用量成本信号，可能改变索引、API 等服务的计费方式。

items.title_en: The AI Credit Resale Economy
items.title_zh: AI 计算信用再销售经济
items.summary_en: An emerging market is forming around trading AI compute credits and usage rights, with token brokers providing liquidity and signaling prices. The system could lower the barrier to AI access for startups and individuals, but it also invites resale scams and regulatory scrutiny as standards and protections emerge.
items.summary_zh: 一个围绕AI计算信用和使用权买卖的新兴市场正在形成，经纪人聚合流动性并传递价格信号。该模式可能降低创业公司和个人获得AI能力的门槛，但随着标准化和保护机制尚未完善，也引发转卖欺诈与监管关注。

items.title_en: Mistral Patent for “Code implemented tool calls”
items.title_zh: Mistral 专利：‘代码实现的工具调用’
items.summary_en: Mistral obtains a patent for code-implemented tool calls, enabling AI models to trigger tools via code generation rather than explicit tool calls.
items.summary_zh: Mistral 获得了关于“通过代码实现工具调用”的专利，允许模型通过生成代码来触发工具，而非直接调用。

items.title_en: France's top court blocks social media ban for under-15s
items.title_zh: 法国最高法院阻止未成年人使用社交媒体的禁令
items.summary_en: France's top court blocked a ban on social media for under-15s, ruling it infringes freedom of expression. The decision frames debates about age-based access, digital rights, and how to protect minors online.
items.summary_zh: 法国最高法院裁定针对未满15岁用户的社交媒体禁令侵犯表达自由，推翻相关规定。这一裁决引发关于未成年在线保护和数字权利的辩论。

items.title_en: Parametron: 50s Japanese computer that uses neither transistors nor vacuum tubes
items.title_zh: Parametron：不使用晶体管或真空管的50年代日本计算机
items.summary_en: Parametron was a 1950s Japanese computer that used parametric oscillators instead of transistors or vacuum tubes. It illustrates an alternative digital-logic approach that helped launch Japan’s early computing era before transistorization.
items.summary_zh: Parametron 是一台1950年代的日本计算机，使用参数振荡器来实现逻辑门，不依赖晶体管或真空管。它展示了在晶体管普及前，不同于传统电子元件的数字逻辑路径，并推动了日本早期计算的发展。

items.title_en: I requested a copy of my data from McDonald’s loyalty program
items.title_zh: 我请求了麦当劳忠诚计划的数据副本
items.summary_en: A reader asked for their data from McDonald’s loyalty program and discovered a 515-page dossier generated from their activity, preferences, and location data. The depth of profiling raises privacy and data-retention concerns about loyalty programs and how this data might be used. It also highlights questions about data portability and consent.
items.summary_zh: 一位用户申请了麦当劳忠诚计划的数据副本，发现系统建立了包含活动、偏好和位置历史在内的约515页档案。此举凸显现代忠诚计划对个人数据的深度采集，引发隐私、数据留存与可移植性方面的担忧。

items.title_en: Humanising LLM Outputs Is Dumb
items.title_zh: 将 LLM 输出人性化其实很愚蠢
items.summary_en: An argument that making AI outputs feel human is misguided, advocating for transparency and reliability over anthropomorphism.
items.summary_zh: 认为让模型输出更具人类特征并不明智，应优先追求透明和可靠性，避免过度拟人化。

items.title_en: What happens when an LLM never sees material beyond fifth grade?
items.title_zh: 当大型语言模型从不接触五年级以上材料时会怎样？
items.summary_en: A thought experiment or study examines how an LLM trained only on rudimentary material handles reasoning tasks, error rates, and generalization. Results shed light on data quality and curriculum design for AI agents.
items.summary_zh: 本研究/思考实验探讨若 LLM 仅接触基础材料，其推理能力、错误率与泛化能力会如何受限。结果揭示数据质量与训练课程设计对 AI 的影响。

items.title_en: Where did the old web go? We followed 657,607 links to find out
items.title_zh: 旧网站去了哪儿？我们追踪了657,607条链接来找答案
items.summary_en: A long-form audit of the web's link rot by tracing hundreds of thousands of links. The findings illustrate the fragility of the link graph and the enduring importance of archiving for preserving web history.
items.summary_zh: 通过追踪数十万条链接的毁坏情况，揭示了网页链接结构的脆弱性。研究强调在数字记忆和档案保存中，链接的长期可持续性有多重要。

items.title_en: I made tinnitus my friend, then it disappeared [video]
items.title_zh: 把耳鸣当朋友，结果消失了 [视频]
items.summary_en: A personal video recounts reframing tinnitus as a companion rather than a nuisance, using attention and habit techniques to reduce distress. It offers a human-sized look at managing chronic sensory noise.
items.summary_zh: 个人视频讲述把耳鸣视为伙伴而非困扰，用专注和习惯训练来缓解困扰。提供处理慢性感官噪声的心智模型与经验。

items.title_en: CFTC declares market emergency, orders Kalshi to continue to operate in New York
items.title_zh: CFTC 宣布市场紧急状态，命令 Kalshi 在纽约继续运营
items.summary_en: The CFTC has invoked emergency authority to ensure Kalshi can keep operating in New York amid market disruptions. The move underscores how regulators manage access to emerging event-based trading platforms while preserving market integrity.
items.summary_zh: 美国商品期货交易委员会宣布在市场混乱时行使紧急权力，确保 Kalshi 能在纽约继续运营。此举凸显监管机构在新兴事件驱动交易平台的准入与市场完整性之间的权衡。

items.title_en: I turned my RSS feeds into an e-ink newspaper to stop reading on my phone
items.title_zh: 我把 RSS 订阅变成电子墨水报纸以减少看手机
items.summary_en: A personal experiment turning RSS feeds into an e-ink newspaper to curb phone reading, exploring a low-friction way to consume information more mindfully.
items.summary_zh: 作者将 RSS 订阅制成电子墨水报纸，以减少在手机上阅读的时间，探索更专注、低干扰的信息获取方式。

items.title_en: Don't classify, hallucinate
items.title_zh: 别再做分类，别让模型产生幻觉！
items.summary_en: The piece argues that forcing ML models into rigid classification tasks can degrade usefulness and invites embracing generative approaches with guardrails. It highlights practical strategies to reduce hallucinations, including prompt design, transparency, and testing against real-world distributions.
items.summary_zh: 文中强调将模型置于僵硬的分类任务容易放大错误，鼓励在某些场景采用生成性方法并设置防错边界。提出通过提示设计、结果透明、基于实际分布的测试等手段来降低幻觉风险。

items.title_en: Rust SIMD on the GPU
items.title_zh: Rust 在 GPU 上的 SIMD
items.summary_en: Rust SIMD on the GPU analyzes how to map Rust’s SIMD-style parallelism to GPU architectures to boost throughput for numeric kernels. It highlights memory transfer, safety, and tooling challenges when crossing CPU-RAM to GPU. Takeaway: offloading compute-heavy Rust workloads to GPUs can yield big speedups, but it demands careful data layout and tool support.
items.summary_zh: Rust 的 SIMD 在 GPU 上的实现探讨将 Rust 的向量并行性映射到 GPU 架构，以提升数值计算的吞吐量。文章指出在 CPU 与显存/显卡之间的数据传输、内存管理与安全性方面的挑战，以及现有工具的不足。要点是：将重量级 Rust 计算下沉到 GPU 可以带来显著加速，但需要精心的数据布局和工具链支持。

items.title_en: Magnitude 7.7 Earthquake – 68 km NNW of Ende, Indonesia
items.title_zh: 印度尼西亚恩德附近地震：M7.7 级，北偏西68公里
items.summary_en: A magnitude 7.7 earthquake struck near Ende, Indonesia, with strong shaking reported. Emergency services will assess damage and responders monitor aftershocks.
items.summary_zh: 印度尼西亚恩德附近发生7.7级地震，震感强烈。救援部门将评估损害并关注余震。

items.title_en: Stripe Clinches over $7B Deal to Buy AI Firm OpenRouter
items.title_zh: Stripe 将以超过70亿美元收购 OpenRouter
items.summary_en: Stripe is nearing a deal to acquire AI startup OpenRouter for more than $7 billion, signaling fintech’s interest in AI infrastructure and data routing capabilities. The move would deepen Stripe’s developer tools and model-ops capabilities, potentially shaping how payments platforms leverage AI. It highlights consolidation in AI infra as a growth lever for fintech players.
items.summary_zh: Stripe 接近以超过 70 亿美元收购 AI 初创公司 OpenRouter，显示金融科技领域对 AI 基础设施和数据路由能力的兴趣。此举有望强化 Stripe 的开发者工具和模型运维能力，可能影响支付平台对 AI 的应用与集成。显示出 AI 基础设施领域的整合正在成为金融科技扩张的新引擎。

items.title_en: Choosing an AI model: one prompt, 11 models, different results
items.title_zh: 同一提示下 11 个模型输出迥异
items.summary_en: An experiment compares a single prompt across 11 AI models, revealing substantial variability in outputs. The findings stress model selection as a critical variable for product teams.
items.summary_zh: 一项实验在同一提示下对 11 个 AI 模型进行比较，结果显示输出差异巨大。研究强调模型选择是产品团队需要重点关注的变量。

items.title_en: Introducing Toast 1
items.title_zh: Toast 1 发布
items.summary_en: Toast 1 announces a new project or product release from Mixed Bread, detailing its goals and potential use cases.
items.summary_zh: 混合面包公司推出 Toast 1 版本，介绍了新产品/项目的目标与潜在应用场景。

items.title_en: eigendrum
items.title_zh: Eigendrum
items.summary_en: Eigendrum appears to be an arts/tech project page, possibly exploring circle-based or eigen-theme visuals or sound.
items.summary_zh: Eigendrum 是一个实验性艺术/科技作品的项目页面，展示与圆形、特征/特征向量等主题相关的创作。

items.title_en: The “mechanical miracle” that ruined Mark Twain’s life
items.title_zh: The 'mechanical miracle' that ruined Mark Twain’s life
items.summary_en: A historical account of a mechanical invention that negatively affected Mark Twain's life, illustrating how technological hype can backfire on creators. It places Twain in the broader context of 19th century innovation and public fascination with machines.
items.summary_zh: 一段关于一件机械发明如何使马克·吐温的生活陷入困境的历史叙述，揭示科技炒作对创作者可能产生的负面影响。

items.title_en: Dear people who work at the airport
items.title_zh: 致机场工作的你们
items.summary_en: A note to airport workers reflecting on the realities of travel hubs and the human side of air transportation, acknowledging their hard work and offering appreciation.
items.summary_zh: 致机场工作者的一封信，反思交通枢纽的现实与人性，致以工作上的感谢与理解。

items.title_en: US hires over 2k video gamers as air traffic controllers
items.title_zh: 美国雇用两千多名视频游戏玩家担任空中交通管制员
items.summary_en: The FAA is recruiting over 2,000 video gamers as air traffic controllers, tapping fast pattern recognition and rapid decision-making skills from gaming. The move demonstrates how gaming experience can translate to high-stakes, real-time work, while raising questions about training pipelines and safety guarantees. Expect debate over qualification standards and how to best staff critical infrastructure.
items.summary_zh: 美国联邦航空局正在招募超过2000名视频游戏玩家担任空中交通管制员，意在利用他们在游戏中培养的快速模式识别与决策能力。这一举措显示了游戏经验向高压实时工作转化的潜力，同时也引发对培训流程与安全保障的讨论。关于资质标准以及如何更好地为关键基础设施配备人力，将展开广泛讨论。

items.title_en: Bluesky Protocol Services
items.title_zh: Bluesky 协议服务上线
items.summary_en: Bluesky launches Protocol Services to host protocol features in the cloud, letting developers run services that implement the AT Protocol rather than hard-coding clients. The move could improve interoperability and developer flexibility, but introduces questions about trust, data locality, and security.
items.summary_zh: Bluesky 推出协议服务，允许在云端托管并运行实现 AT Protocol 的服务，提升跨应用互操作性与开发者灵活性，同时引发信任、数据归属与安全等议题。

items.title_en: How Compaction Works in Pi
items.title_zh: Pi 中的压缩如何工作
items.summary_en: Describes how data compaction works in Pi, outlining techniques to reduce storage while maintaining acceptable fidelity.
items.summary_zh: 介绍 Pi 中的数据压缩/紧凑化工作原理，概述在保持可接受保真度的前提下降低存储需求的做法。文中讨论了块级共享、编码方案，以及压缩比与访问速度之间的权衡。

items.title_en: Show HN: Voice driven murder mystery, Interview AI suspects with your voice
items.title_zh: Show HN：用语音与 AI 嫌疑人对话的谋杀悬疑游戏
items.summary_en: Show HN project where you conduct interviews with AI suspects using only your voice, turning a classic mystery into an interactive, voice-controlled experience. The project showcases the potential of natural-language interfaces and real-time AI dialogue, with entertainment value and design trade-offs around privacy and trust.
items.summary_zh: Show HN：通过语音与 AI 嫌疑人对话的互动推理游戏，将传统谜案转化为语音驱动的体验。该项目展示了自然语言界面和实时 AI 对话的潜力，兼具娱乐性与对隐私、信任的设计权衡。

items.title_en: New Bedford police officer accused of using Flock cameras to track ex-partner
items.title_zh: 新贝德福德警官被指控使用 Flock 摄像头追踪前伴侣
items.summary_en: An officer from New Bedford is accused of abusing Flock camera feeds to monitor an ex-partner. The case raises concerns about surveillance network governance and potential misuse by law enforcement.
items.summary_zh: 新贝德福德的一名警官被控滥用 Flock 摄像头监视前伴侣。这一案件突显了监控网络的治理不足和执法部门可能的滥用风险。

items.title_en: Flutter 3.47
items.title_zh: Flutter 3.47 新特性一览
items.summary_en: Flutter 3.47 ships with refinements across performance, tooling, and platform support, making it easier to build fast, beautiful apps across mobile, web, and desktop. The update emphasizes compile-time improvements, better UX tooling, and evolving widgets to meet developer needs.
items.summary_zh: Flutter 3.47 在性能、工具链和跨平台支持方面带来改进，便于在移动、网页和桌面端快速打造高效美观的应用。 更新强调编译时优化、用户体验工具和组件演进，以满足开发者需求。

items.title_en: Kubernetes on Oxide: How customer needs shaped our integrations
items.title_zh: Oxide 上的 Kubernetes：客户需求如何塑造我们的集成
items.summary_en: This piece explains how customer needs influenced Oxide's Kubernetes integrations, reflecting how a hardware-focused platform balances Kubernetes standards with real-world constraints. It offers insights into tailoring orchestration for edge and dense hardware scenarios.
items.summary_zh: 本文阐述了客户需求如何影响 Oxide 的 Kubernetes 集成，展示了面向硬件的平台如何在遵循 Kubernetes 标准与现实约束之间取得平衡。为在边缘与密集硬件场景中定制编排提供了见解。

items.title_en: Analyzing data from Silicon Valley ventures and founders prosecuted for fraud
items.title_zh: 分析来自硅谷风险投资与被控欺诈的创始人数据
items.summary_en: An academic study analyzes data on Silicon Valley ventures and founders prosecuted for fraud to identify patterns and risk factors. The findings point to governance gaps, over-optimism, and misaligned incentives that can enable fraud, underscoring the need for stronger due diligence and oversight in venture funding.
items.summary_zh: 该研究分析硅谷风险投资与因欺诈被起诉的创始人数据，揭示治理缺口、过度乐观与激励错位等风险因素。研究强调需要更严格的尽职调查与监管，以抑制欺诈行为并提升投资透明度。

items.title_en: Company Offering '100% Human-Written, Never AI' Medical Research Is 100% AI
items.title_zh: 声称‘100% 人工撰写、从不使用 AI’ 的医学研究公司 实际上 全部由 AI 生成
items.summary_en: A company claiming to publish '100% human-written, never AI' medical research is revealed to be entirely AI-generated. The revelation underscores risks of misleading scientific communication and pressures on peer review.
items.summary_zh: 一家公司声称提供‘100% 人工撰写、从不使用 AI’ 的医学研究，但事实却是全部由 AI 生成。这一发现突显了科学传播中的误导风险，以及对同行评审体系的压力。

items.title_en: Facebook ads are so hard to block that uBlock Origin stopped filtering them
items.title_zh: Facebook 广告难以拦截，uBlock Origin 停止过滤
items.summary_en: Facebook ads have become so hard to block that a popular ad blocker stopped filtering them, illustrating an ongoing arms race between platform monetization and ad-blocking tools. The episode highlights the challenges of keeping users from unwanted ads and the limits of browser-based privacy tools. It invites questions about user choice, transparency, and blocking effectiveness.
items.summary_zh: Facebook 广告变得难以拦截，知名广告拦截工具甚至停止了对其过滤，凸显了平台变现策略与广告拦截工具之间的持续博弈。这一事件凸显了让用户屏蔽广告的难度以及浏览器隐私工具的局限性，也引发关于用户选择、透明度与拦截效果的讨论。

items.title_en: Amazon backs power plant that may become top source of US climate pollution
items.title_zh: 亚马逊支持的发电厂或成美国最大的气候污染源
items.summary_en: Amazon backs a fossil-fueled power plant that could become the top source of climate pollution in the U.S., potentially conflicting with its climate pledges. The choice spotlights tensions between reliability, economics, and environmental commitments in big-tech supply chains.
items.summary_zh: 亚马逊资助的燃气发电站可能成为美国最大的气候污染源，似乎与公司自述的气候承诺相冲突。这一举措凸显供应链弹性、能源经济与环保承诺之间的矛盾，或将影响相关政策和能源投资议题。

items.title_en: 50k Boat Names
items.title_zh: 5万条船名数据集
items.summary_en: A dataset of 50,000 boat names offers a ready-made resource for NLP, branding tests, and string-processing experiments. It also reveals cultural quirks in naming and can serve as a testbed for name-generation and anomaly detection.
items.summary_zh: 5万条船名的数据集提供了一个现成的资源，可用于自然语言处理、品牌测试以及字符串处理实验。它也反映了命名文化的趣味性，适合作为名字生成和异常检测的测试场景。

items.title_en: Ask HN: In your experience, what are sound conventions for e-ink UI development?
items.title_zh: Ask HN：在你们的经验中，电子墨水界面开发有哪些成熟的设计准则？
items.summary_en: Ask HN asks for established conventions for designing UI on e-ink displays, covering readability, refresh strategies, and power efficiency.
items.summary_zh: Ask HN 征询在电子墨水显示屏上进行 UI 设计的公认准则，包括可读性、刷新策略与省电性等。

items.title_en: The Human Is the Loop
items.title_zh: 人是循环中的一环
items.summary_en: The Human Is the Loop argues humans remain essential in AI systems, not as optional add-ons but as core control and interpretation nodes. It discusses practical patterns for humane, effective human-in-the-loop workflows, including feedback, oversight, and accountability. The takeaway is to balance automation with human judgment to build robust systems.
items.summary_zh: 《人是循环中的一环》认为人类在 AI 系统中仍然不可或缺，不是可选的附加环节，而是核心的控制与解读节点。文中探讨了高效的人机循环工作流的实际做法，包括反馈、监督与问责等要素。核心观点是在自动化与人类判断之间找到平衡，以构建更稳健的系统。

items.title_en: Jolt: Clojure compiler implemented with Chez Scheme
items.title_zh: Jolt：用 Chez Scheme 实现的 Clojure 编译器
items.summary_en: Jolt is a Clojure compiler implemented on Chez Scheme, leveraging Scheme's runtime to execute Clojure semantics. This approach offers an alternative path to efficient compilation and portability, blending Lisp ecosystems.
items.summary_zh: Jolt 是一个在 Chez Scheme 上实现的 Clojure 编译器，利用 Scheme 的运行时来承载 Clojure 的语义。这种做法展示了 Lisp 系列语言之间的互通性，并可能带来编译效率与可移植性的新路径。

items.title_en: Magnitude 7.4 Earthquake – 5 km S of San José del Palmar, Colombia
items.title_zh: 哥伦比亚圣何塞德尔帕尔马尔以南5公里发生7.4级地震
items.summary_en: USGS reports a magnitude 7.4 earthquake near San José del Palmar, Colombia, with potential aftershocks and regional disruption. Authorities urge preparedness as seismic activity continues in the region.
items.summary_zh: 美国地质调查局报告在哥伦比亚圣何塞德尔帕尔马尔以南5公里发生7.4级地震，可能出现余震并造成地区性扰动。相关部门呼吁加强应急准备，区域地震活动仍在持续。

items.title_en: Thanks to social media, canned sardines are a scarcity on the supermarket shelf
items.title_zh: 多亏社交媒体，罐头沙丁鱼成了超市货架上的稀缺品
items.summary_en: A social media stir has driven sudden demand for canned sardines, leading to shortages in supermarkets. The story highlights how online chatter can disrupt traditional supply and reveal fragilities in niche food supply chains, even for everyday staples.
items.summary_zh: 社媒的热议推动了罐头沙丁鱼的突增需求，导致不少超市缺货。这一现象揭示了网络话题如何冲击传统供应链，暴露了对日常必需品的脆弱性。

items.title_en: What I learned by putting GitHub Copilot behind a MitM proxy
items.title_zh: 把 GitHub Copilot 放在中间人代理后学到的教训
items.summary_en: A MITM proxy experiment on GitHub Copilot reveals what data is sent and how prompts travel, highlighting potential privacy risks and the need for clearer data handling controls and opt-out options for developers.
items.summary_zh: 在 MITM 代理下测试 GitHub Copilot 暴露了数据传输和提示流向，揭示潜在隐私风险，并促使业界对数据处理和可选退出机制进行更清晰的规定。

items.title_en: Exploiting System Management Mode with a very long interrupt
items.title_zh: 利用极长中断攻击系统管理模式
items.summary_en: A proof-of-concept demonstrates how extremely long System Management Mode (SMM) interrupts can be abused to escalate privileges or leak data from firmware. The work underscores firmware security risks and the need for robust isolation in modern CPUs.
items.summary_zh: 一个概念性演示显示，极长的系统管理模式中断可能被用于提升权限或从固件窃取数据，暴露了固件层面的安全风险并强调需要在现代 CPU 中实现更强的隔离。

items.title_en: 'Pervert glasses': Backlash against Meta's smart glasses grows
items.title_zh: “变态眼镜”标签：对 Meta 智能眼镜的反对声日益高涨
items.summary_en: Backlash against Meta's smart glasses grows, with critics labeling the product 'pervert glasses' and citing privacy and design concerns. The debate underscores how AR hardware faces scrutiny over social impact and user trust.
items.summary_zh: 公众对 Meta 智能眼镜的反对声持续增强，批评者指向隐私、物化和设计问题。此波讨论凸显了增强现实硬件野心与用户信任之间的张力，可能影响普及速度和监管关注。

items.title_en: OpenChamber: An Agentic Development Environment
items.title_zh: OpenChamber：一个具代理能力的开发环境
items.summary_en: OpenChamber presents a development environment oriented around agentic AI, enabling developers to design, test, and monitor autonomous agents within an integrated toolchain. The project emphasizes traceability, safety, and reproducibility for agent-based workflows.
items.summary_zh: OpenChamber 提供一个以代理能力为核心的开发环境，使开发者能够在一体化工具链中设计、测试并监控自主代理。该项目强调可追溯性、安全性与在基于代理的工作流中的可重复性。

items.title_en: Making holograms with a pen plotter
items.title_zh: 用笔绘图机制作全息图
items.summary_en: A maker demonstrates how a standard pen plotter can be repurposed to generate holographic light patterns, illustrating accessible DIY optics that blend hardware hacking with creative visuals.
items.summary_zh: 一位创客展示如何将普通的笔绘图机改造成产生全息光场的设备，演示开源硬件在光学实验中的潜力。该项目降低了 DIY 全息成像的门槛，或为教育与创意展示提供新思路。

items.title_en: Show HN: Eigendrum - Draw any shape and hear what it sounds like as a drum
items.title_zh: Show HN：Eigendrum——绘制任意形状并听到它的鼓声
items.summary_en: Eigendrum lets you draw shapes and hear the sonic result as drum-like sounds, blending geometric input with physical-inspired sound synthesis. It's a playful intersection of geometry and audio tech.
items.summary_zh: Eigendrum 让你绘制形状并听到其鼓声效果，将几何输入与基于物理的声音合成相结合，兼具趣味与技术亮点。

items.title_en: U of Michigan drops first-semester grades to ‘curb mental health crisis’
items.title_zh: 密歇根大学将第一学期成绩下调以缓解心理健康危机
items.summary_en: University of Michigan lowers first-semester grades to curb mental health crisis, exploring the impact of grading policies on student well-being.
items.summary_zh: 密歇根大学为缓解心理健康危机而下调第一学期成绩，探讨评分政策对学生福祉的影响。文章分析在学术标准与学生支持之间的平衡问题。

items.title_en: AI in drug discovery – what it is, where we stand and the path forward
items.title_zh: 药物发现中的人工智能：现状、意义与未来路径
items.summary_en: AI in drug discovery has matured to deliver predictive models, virtual screening, and de novo design at scale, but data quality, interpretability, and regulatory considerations remain key challenges. The piece outlines current capabilities, bottlenecks, and the path forward for safer, faster pharmaceutical research powered by AI.
items.summary_zh: 药物发现中的AI已在预测建模、虚拟筛选和全新设计方面取得阶段性进展，但数据质量、可解释性与监管合规仍是关键挑战。文章梳理了当前的能力、瓶颈以及以AI驱动的更安全、更高效药物研发的未来路径。

items.title_en: The weekend is 100 years old
items.title_zh: 周末已成百年历史
items.summary_en: The weekend marks a century of structured leisure, with shifts in work culture like Friday skiving and hybrid work challenging traditional norms. The piece questions how to preserve rest and balance in a modern economy.
items.summary_zh: 周末作为社会制度化的休息与休闲概念已有百年历史，文章回顾它起源、工作文化中的周五休闲现象，以及混合工作模式对休闲与生产力的挑战。对未来如何平衡工作与生活提出思考。

items.title_en: A controversial Alzheimer's surgery is said to reverse symptoms
items.title_zh: 一项有争议的阿尔茨海默病手术据称能逆转症状
items.summary_en: Early reports describe a controversial surgical approach yielding reversal of some Alzheimer's symptoms in a subset of patients, sparking debate over ethics, patient selection, and long-term outcomes. Proponents push for controlled trials and transparency.
items.summary_zh: 早期报道指一种有争议的手术在部分患者身上可逆转部分症状，引发伦理、患者筛选及长期效果的讨论。支持者呼吁进行受控试验并提高透明度。

items.title_en: Run Android ARM64 VR APKs on Apple Vision Pro
items.title_zh: 在 Apple Vision Pro 上运行 Android ARM64 VR 应用包
