items.summary_zh: 加州垃圾填埋场地下火灾蔓延，释放有毒烟雾并影响空气与地下水。当地当局正加强监测与处置，环境健康风险需关注。

items.title_en: Solving the Shortest Vector Problem in $2^{0.6039n}$ Time via Mid-Point Hessian
items.title_zh: 通过中点 Hessian 的方法在 2^{0.6039n} 时间内解决最短向量问题
items.summary_en: A new approach solves the Shortest Vector Problem in roughly 2^{0.6039n} time using a mid-point Hessian technique, advancing lattice-based cryptanalysis and potentially tightening security margins for lattice-based cryptosystems.
items.summary_zh: 提出一种新方法，利用中点 Hessian 技术以约 2^{0.6039n} 的时间解决最短向量问题，推动格基密码分析并可能收紧基于格的加密系统的安全裕度。

items.title_en: Updated GPG Key for Signing Firefox and Thunderbird Releases
items.title_zh: 用于签署 Firefox 与 Thunderbird 发行版的更新 GPG 密钥
items.summary_en: Mozilla updates the GPG signing key for Firefox and Thunderbird releases, reinforcing supply-chain security. The change affects how users verify official builds, so upgrading trust is prudent.
items.summary_zh: Mozilla 发布了用于 Firefox 与 Thunderbird 发行签名的新 GPG 密钥，提升供应链安全性。建议开发者和用户更新信任锚点并重新验证签名。

items.title_en: The Law of Jante (2015)
items.title_zh: 扬特法则（2015）
items.summary_en: The Paris Review revisits the Law of Jante, a social code discouraging individual boasting and promoting conformity. The piece reflects on how such norms shape creativity, ambition, and collaboration in tech culture.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章重新审视扬特法则，揭示抑制个人炫耀、推崇群体一致的社会规范如何影响创造力、野心和科技圈的协作文化。

items.title_en: Government sponsored study on alcohol doesn't stand up to scrutiny
items.title_zh: 政府资助的酒精研究经不起审视
items.summary_en: Questioning the rigor of a government-sponsored alcohol study, the author argues it relies on flawed methodology or biased interpretation. The piece illustrates how public-funded research can mislead or overstate findings, urging stricter scrutiny and transparency.
items.summary_zh: 批评政府资助的酒精研究，指出其方法学存在缺陷或解读偏颇。此文揭示了公共资金研究可能误导结论的问题，呼吁提高透明度和审查力度。

items.title_en: DEF CON crowd suspected in fake-hotspot attack on Delta flight
items.title_zh: DEF CON 观众群体被指卷入达美航班的伪热点攻击
items.summary_en: DEF CON crowd suspected in fake-hotspot attack on Delta flight highlights vulnerabilities in in-flight networks and the risk of social-engineering style attacks at conferences. It underscores need for robust network authentication and threat modeling.
items.summary_zh: DEF CON 观众群体被指卷入达美航班的伪热点攻击，暴露了机上网络的脆弱性与会展环境中的社交工程风险。强调需要更强的网络认证和威胁建模。

items.title_en: My Rules for Using Spreadsheets
items.title_zh: 我在使用电子表格时的规则
items.summary_en: The post lays out practical rules for spreadsheet hygiene, including data separation, validation, versioning, and avoiding brittle formulas. It offers actionable guidelines to improve accuracy, maintainability, and collaboration on spreadsheets.
items.summary_zh: 文章提出使用电子表格的实用规则，如数据分离、输入校验、版本控制以及避免易断的公式。给出可落地的建议，提升表格的准确性、可维护性与协作效率。

items.title_en: Immersion lithography saved Moore's Law (2023)
items.title_zh: 浸没式光刻在2023年拯救了摩尔定律
items.summary_en: Immersion lithography helped sustain transistor scaling in 2023 by enabling finer features while EUV rollout matured slowly. The piece underscores how continued improvement in existing lithography methods kept progress alive.
items.summary_zh: 浸没式光刻在 2023 年帮助维持晶体管微缩的步伐，使更小的特征尺寸成为可能，尽管 EUV 产线推进尚需时间。文章强调现有光刻技术的持续改进对维持制程进展的重要性。

items.title_en: Show HN: Ballet – Workflow automation that writes integrations against any API
items.title_zh: Show HN：Ballet——为任意 API 写集成的工作流自动化工具
items.summary_en: Show HN: Ballet automates workflow creation by generating integrations against any API, lowering the barrier to building data pipelines and app integrations. It translates API specs into executable workflows, enabling faster integration development.
items.summary_zh: Show HN：Ballet 通过自动生成对任意 API 的集成工作流来执行 API 集成，降低搭建数据管线和应用集成的门槛。它把 API 规格转化为可执行的工作流，显著提升开发效率。

items.title_en: Show HN: Quasicrystals Animation Playground with WebXR
items.title_zh: Show HN：WebXR 的准晶体动画练习场
items.summary_en: Show HN: Quasicrystals Animation Playground with WebXR offers an interactive web-based space to experiment with quasicrystal visuals in VR/AR. It showcases how WebXR enables rich geometry demos without heavy toolchains.
items.summary_zh: Show HN：基于 WebXR 的准晶体动画练习场提供一个可互动的网页环境，在 VR/AR 中试验准晶体视觉效果，展示 WebXR 如何在无需重度工具链的情况下实现丰富几何演示。

items.title_en: California Uber, Lyft drivers win union recognition
items.title_zh: 加州的 Uber、Lyft 司机获工会承认
items.summary_en: California's gig drivers won union recognition, marking a milestone for organizing on-demand work and potentially reshaping wages, benefits and working conditions in the ride-hailing economy. The decision could influence policy and bargaining power across the broader gig ecosystem.
items.summary_zh: 加州的网约车司机获得工会承认，标志着按需工作领域组织的一个重要里程碑，并可能重新塑造打车服务的工资、福利与工作条件。 这一决定或将影响政策制定和整个零工生态系统的谈判力。

items.title_en: Show HN: KidScreen, a finite YouTube shelf chosen by parents
items.title_zh: Show HN：KidScreen——父母挑选的受控 YouTube 收藏夹
items.summary_en: A Show HN introducing KidScreen, a curated YouTube shelf chosen by parents. The project aims to provide safer, age-appropriate content filters and a simpler front-end experience for families.
items.summary_zh: Show HN 介绍 KidScreen，这是一份由家长挑选的受控 YouTube 收藏夹，旨在提供更安全、适龄的内容筛选，并为家庭用户提供简洁的浏览体验。

items.title_en: I built a browser-native SysEx librarian for 80s/90s synthesizers
items.title_zh: 我用浏览器本地实现了一个用于 80/90 年代合成器的 SysEx 管理器
items.summary_en: A browser-native SysEx librarian lets musicians manage patch data for vintage synths directly in the browser, avoiding desktop software. It highlights the resurgence of web-based music tooling and keeping legacy gear accessible.
items.summary_zh: 浏览器端的 SysEx 管理器让音乐人能在网页中管理 80/90 年代合成器的补丁数据，减少对桌面软件的依赖。体现了网络音乐工具的复兴。

items.title_en: Health benefits of Tai Chi
items.title_zh: 太极的健康益处
items.summary_en: Harvard Health outlines Tai Chi's health benefits, including improved balance, flexibility, and cardiovascular fitness, with evidence from recent studies. The low-impact practice is accessible to a wide range of ages and abilities.
items.summary_zh: 太极对健康有益的证据综述显示它能改善平衡、柔韧性和心血管健康，且适合不同年龄群体练习。

items.title_en: Show HN: OJCP – an open protocol for agent-consumable job data
items.title_zh: OJCP——面向代理可消费作业数据的开放协议
items.summary_en: OJCP defines an open protocol for agent-consumable job data to enable interoperability between AI agents and consumers. The project aims to standardize data exchange in automated workflows and multi-agent setups.
items.summary_zh: OJCP 定义了一个开放协议，用于在代理与消费者之间交换作业数据，推动多方协作和系统互操作性的发展。

items.title_en: The mathematical physics of rainbows and glories (2001) [pdf]
items.title_zh: 彩虹与辉光的数学物理（2001）
items.summary_en: A 2001 paper explores the math and physics behind rainbows and glories, applying wave optics and scattering theory to explain angular patterns and color separation. It’s a classic cross-section of mathematical physics and atmospheric optics.
items.summary_zh: 2001 年的论文结合波动光学与散射理论解释彩虹与辉光的形成机制，属于数学物理在大气光学中的经典案例。

items.title_en: Debugging Information for Inlined Functions
items.title_zh: 内联函数的调试信息
items.summary_en: The article explains how debugging information for inlined functions is represented, and what information compilers emit to make sense of inlining. It covers techniques to preserve useful stack traces and variable scopes despite inlining, improving post-mortem debugging.
items.summary_zh: 文章探讨了内联函数在调试信息中的表示方式，以及编译器如何输出调试信息以便在优化后仍能追踪源代码。介绍了在内联导致栈帧和变量作用域变化时，调试工具应如何保持有用的调试信息。

items.title_en: The Three-Stroke Problem
items.title_zh: 三笔画问题
items.summary_en: A crisp discussion of a classic three-stroke rendering problem, framed around vector design tooling.
items.summary_zh: 三笔画问题是一则经典的绘制/排版难题，在 Penpot 的设计背景下被讨论。其核心涉及在有限笔画条件下实现稳定的形状与连贯性，对矢量设计工具有启发意义。

items.title_en: Humazon
items.title_zh: Humazon
items.summary_en: Humazon explores the overlap of human-centric design and platform ecosystems, inviting reflection on how digital infrastructures shape behavior, work, and meaning. The piece uses a speculative lens to critique or envision future tech cultures.
items.summary_zh: Humazon 探讨以人为本的设计如何与大型平台生态相互作用，促使读者反思数字基础设施对行为、工作与意义的塑造。通过投射性视角，对未来科技文化进行批判性思考与设想。

items.title_en: Nvidia discloses $21B stake in SpaceX at end of second quarter
items.title_zh: 英伟达披露在 SpaceX 的210亿美元持股
items.summary_en: NVIDIA reveals a $21 billion stake in SpaceX at end of Q2, signaling strategic alignment between AI hardware players and the broader space/rocket ecosystem. The disclosure hints at potential collaboration on AI-enabled launches, data processing, and cloud-like capabilities around SpaceX’s operations.
items.summary_zh: 英伟达在第二季度末披露持有 SpaceX 210 亿美元的股份，显示出 AI 硬件厂商与太空/航天生态之间的潜在协同。此披露可能预示双方在 AI 加持的发射、数据处理及云计算能力等方面的潜在合作。

items.title_en: Before Rightmove, there was the Cosmorama
items.title_zh: 在 Rightmove 之前的 Cosmorama：伦敦的房产信息创新
items.summary_en: Cosmorama was an early London property display system that foreshadowed modern real estate portals, visually presenting listings to the public. The piece situates this forgotten innovation within the lineage of property data and search experiences.
items.summary_zh: Cosmorama 是伦敦早期的房产信息展示系统，可视化呈现房源信息，成为现代房地产门户的前身。文章把这项被遗忘的创新置于房产数据、城市迁移与搜索体验的发展脉络中。

items.title_en: From 13.5M installs to 499 active devices
items.title_zh: 从 1350 万次安装到 499 台活跃设备
items.summary_en: A retrospective look at app ecosystems comparing 13.5 million installs to a fraction of active devices, highlighting user retention challenges and changing monetization/engagement strategies over time.
items.summary_zh: 回顾性分析显示应用安装量巨大但活跃设备远少于安装总量，揭示用户留存与平台演变带来的挑战及商业模式的变化。

items.title_en: Locating an unknown source of radiation in a heterogeneous environment (2019)
items.title_zh: 在异质环境中定位未知辐射源（2019）
items.summary_en: A 2019 study tackles locating an unknown radiation source in a heterogeneous environment using inverse methods and signal processing. The approach has implications for nuclear safety, environmental monitoring, and geophysical sensing where material variability matters.
items.summary_zh: 2019 年的研究聚焦在异质介质环境中定位未知辐射源，使用反问题和信号处理方法。该方法对核安全、环境监测与地球物理探测具有现实意义，尤其在材料多样性显著的场景中。

items.title_en: Brazilian election filter in X For You timeline
items.title_zh: X For You 时间线中的巴西大选筛选器
items.summary_en: A filter for the X For You timeline targets Brazilian 2026 election content, illustrating how platform-level controls shape political discourse and information exposure.
items.summary_zh: 在 X 的 For You 时间线中新增巴西 2026 大选内容筛选器，展示平台级控制如何影响政治话语与信息暴露。

items.title_en: Archie G. Norcross' Maine Forest Fire Maps (1918–22)
items.title_zh: Archie G. Norcross 的缅因州森林火灾地图（1918–22）
items.summary_en: Archie G. Norcross' Maine Forest Fire Maps (1918–22) reveal early 20th-century fire geography and mapping methods. The collection offers historical data for ecology and risk planning, illustrating how communities tracked wildfires before modern GIS.
items.summary_zh: Archie G. Norcross 的缅因州森林火灾地图（1918–1922）展示了早期火灾地理与制图方法。该收藏为历史生态和风险规划提供数据，体现了在现代 GIS 出现前人们如何记录与理解野火。

items.title_en: The deep history behind the Road to Nowhere inside the Great Smoky Mountains
items.title_zh: 大烟山中的“无路可走”之路的深层历史
items.summary_en: The Road to Nowhere in the Great Smoky Mountains has a deep history tied to park politics, infrastructure ambitions, and scenic access. The piece explains why the road was built, why it remains contentious, and how it shaped the region.
items.summary_zh: 大烟山国家公园的‘通往无处的路’有着深厚的历史根源，涉及公园政治、基础设施野心与游客通达。文章解读这条路为何建成、为何引发争议，以及它如何影响了区域发展。

items.title_en: SQRL wan't wrong, it was early
items.title_zh: SQRL 不是错在它，而是来得太早
items.summary_en: A retrospective argues SQRL's ideas were sound but ahead of their time, with adoption hampered by ecosystem readiness. It suggests some current authentication trends echo SQRL's concepts.
items.summary_zh: 回顾性文章认为 SQRL 的思想本身并无错，但来得太早，生态尚未成熟。当前认证趋势中仍能看到一些受其启发的想法。

items.title_en: The Story of Mac: A Just-So Story
items.title_zh: Mac 的故事：一个就像童话的叙事
items.summary_en: The Story of Mac: A Just-So Story offers a playful tracing of how design choices and corporate strategy shaped the Macintosh lineage.
items.summary_zh: 《Mac 的故事》以轻松笔触回顾 Macintosh 的诞生与演变，揭示设计哲学与商业决策如何塑造了苹果电脑的走向。

items.title_en: Show HN: I built a native app for coding agents with Rust and GPUI
items.title_zh: Show HN：我用 Rust 与 GPUI 构建了一个用于编码代理的原生应用
items.summary_en: I built a native app for coding agents using Rust and GPUI to demonstrate local, GPU-accelerated AI tooling. The project highlights how performance-minded desktop apps can host intelligent agents without relying on the cloud.
items.summary_zh: 我用 Rust 与 GPUI 构建了一个用于编码代理的原生应用，展示在本地环境中使用 GPU 加速的 AI 工具如何提升性能与响应速度。

items.title_en: Strait of Hormuz Live Traffic Tracking
items.title_zh: 霍尔木兹海峡实时交通追踪
items.summary_en: A live tracking system monitors vessel movements through the Strait of Hormuz, offering near real-time density, routes, and chokepoint dynamics. The project highlights how open maritime data and visualization enable logistics awareness and geopolitical risk assessment.
items.summary_zh: 实时追踪系统监控通过霍尔木兹海峡的船舶动向，提供近实时的密度、航线与关口动态。此类海事数据可视化增强物流洞察与地缘政治风险评估。

items.title_en: Reticulum – Decentralized Mesh Network
items.title_zh: Reticulum 去中心化网状网络
items.summary_en: Reticulum is a decentralized mesh network project aiming to provide resilient, censorship-resistant communications without relying on centralized infrastructure. It emphasizes privacy-preserving routing and offline-first capability, enabling devices to talk directly in ad-hoc networks.
items.summary_zh: Reticulum 是一个去中心化的网状网络项目，致力于在不依赖集中基础设施的情况下提供稳健、抗审查的通信。它强调隐私友好的路由和离线优先能力，使设备能够在临时网络中直接互联。

items.title_en: Claude Is Down
items.title_zh: Claude 已宕机
items.summary_en: Claude is down again, signaling an outage affecting access to Claude AI services. The incident underscores the resilience needs for critical AI tooling and the business risks of relying on single-provider infrastructure.
items.summary_zh: Claude 再次宕机，表明对 Claude AI 服务的访问受到影响。这一事件凸显对关键 AI 工具的韧性需求，以及依赖单一供应商基础设施所带来的业务风险。

items.title_en: Treasury Orders Erasure of Domestic Ownership Records
items.title_zh: 财政部下令抹去国内所有权记录
items.summary_en: The Treasury issues a directive to erase domestic ownership records from public or regulatory records, a move that raises questions about transparency, regulatory compliance, and privacy in corporate governance. The policy may streamline data handling but could complicate tracing beneficial owners and ensuring accountability.
items.summary_zh: 财政部发布指令，要求从公开或监管记录中抹去国内所有权信息。这一举措引发关于透明度、合规性与公司治理问责的讨论。此举可能简化数据处理，但也可能让追踪实际受益所有人和确保问责变得更加困难。

items.title_en: Zapping Rocks Unlocks Stimulated Geologic Hydrogen
items.title_zh: 击打岩石释放受激的地质氢气
items.summary_en: Researchers show that stimulating rocks can release geologic hydrogen, a potential energy carrier. The work demonstrates a mechanism for hydrogen production underground, which could impact energy storage and carbon-free fuel tech, though scalability and safety remain questions.
items.summary_zh: 研究表明对岩石进行受激处理可释放地质氢气，作为潜在的能量载体。此项工作揭示地下氢气生成的机制，或对能源存储和碳中性燃料领域产生影响，但规模化与安全性仍待评估。

items.title_en: Rhombus 1.1 is now available
items.title_zh: Rhombus 1.1 发布
items.summary_en: Rhombus 1.1 is released, delivering updates and improvements to the language's syntax, tooling, and ecosystem. The release focuses on improved ergonomics for developers and better integration with the Racket ecosystem.
items.summary_zh: Rhombus 1.1 已发布，带来语言语法、工具链及生态系统方面的更新。该版本旨在提升开发者体验并加强与 Racket 生态的集成。

items.title_en: Ordinary WiFi can now identify you with near-perfect accuracy
items.title_zh: 普通 WiFi 现可实现近乎完美的身份识别
items.summary_en: Ordinary WiFi signals can be used to identify individuals with near-perfect accuracy through device-free sensing, raising privacy concerns. The finding spurs discussion on secure-by-default networking and potential mitigations like channel obfuscation or anonymization.
items.summary_zh: 普通 WiFi 信号现被用来几乎完美识别个体，引发对隐私的严重担忧。研究推动对默认安全的重新思考，并提出通过信道混淆、匿名化等方法降低风险。

items.title_en: The Hat and the Spectre – Recent Groundbreaking Discoveries in Mathematics
items.title_zh: 帽子与幽灵：数学领域的最新突破
items.summary_en: The Hat and the Spectre surveys recent mathematical breakthroughs, weaving together ideas from combinatorics, analysis, and topology. The piece spotlights results with potential implications for cryptography, numerical methods, and theory.
items.summary_zh: 《帽子与幽灵》回顾了近来的数学突破，展示组合学、分析学与拓扑等领域的新进展及其相互关联。报道强调这些结果对密码学、数值方法和理论研究的潜在影响。

items.title_en: Were Touch Bar's problems software rather than hardware?
items.title_zh: Were Touch Bar 的问题是软件还是硬件？
items.summary_en: A deeper look argues that Touch Bar issues were largely software problems rather than hardware defects, discussing drivers, OS compatibility, and user experience implications.
items.summary_zh: 深入分析认为触控条的问题主要来自软件层面，而非硬件，讨论驱动、操作系统兼容性与用户体验等因素。

items.title_en: Anthropic CEO says the way for AI to win over the public is to cure cancer
items.title_zh: Anthropic CEO：AI 赢得公众需要攻克癌症
items.summary_en: Anthropic's CEO argues that public acceptance of AI hinges on delivering tangible social benefits, such as advances toward curing cancer. The remark frames AI alignment and ethics in terms of real-world, high-impact outcomes.
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 首席执行官认为，公众接受 AI 的关键在于取得切实的社会利益，如攻克癌症。此言将 AI 的对齐与伦理放在对现实世界高影响成果的框架内。

items.title_en: Anthropic IPO valuation hinges on $190-200B 2028 revenue forecast
items.title_zh: Anthropic 的 IPO 估值取决于 2028 年的收入预测
items.summary_en: Anthropic’s IPO valuation is pegged to a 2028 revenue forecast of roughly $190–200 billion, a metric that could set ambitious market expectations. The piece notes the uncertainty and risk in projecting AI revenue that far out, given competition, regulation, and deployment timing, while still signaling strong investor interest in AI copilots and safety-focused firms.
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 的首次公开募股估值高度依赖于到 2028 年的收入预测，约为 1900–2000 亿美元。这一高位预测有望驱动市场预期，同时也暴露出在竞争、监管与部署时序等不确定性下对 AI 收入的长期预测风险。

items.title_en: Claude Seems Down
items.title_zh: Claude 似乎宕机
items.summary_en: Claude AI is experiencing outages or degraded performance, with users reporting slow responses or failures. The outage underscores the fragility of hosted AI services and the importance of multi-provider resilience and graceful degradation.
items.summary_zh: Claude AI 正遭遇宕机或性能下降，用户报告响应变慢甚至失败。这次停机凸显托管式 AI 服务的脆弱性，也强调了多供应商冗余和优雅降级的重要性。

items.title_en: Oracle – a photorealistic browser for every Magic card ever printed
items.title_zh: Oracle：一个用于查看每张印刷过的《魔法：聚会》卡牌的高保真浏览器
items.summary_en: Oracle is a photorealistic browser for viewing every Magic: The Gathering card ever printed, bundling high-fidelity rendering with a searchable card database for collectors and players.
items.summary_zh: Oracle 是一个用于查看每张印刷过的《魔法：聚会》卡牌的高保真浏览器，整合图像渲染和可检索的卡牌数据库，供收藏者与玩家使用。

items.title_en: Site removes all the clutter from recipe videos and gives just the recipe
items.title_zh: CutRecipe：将食谱视频中的冗余剔除，只呈现食谱步骤
items.summary_en: CutRecipe strips away video clutter to present only the recipe steps, offering a focused viewing experience for cooking content.
items.summary_zh: CutRecipe 将食谱视频中不必要的部分去除，只保留关键的食谱步骤，提供更专注的观看体验。

items.title_en: Bedtime Procrastination
items.title_zh: 就寝拖延
items.summary_en: A psychological overview of why people delay going to bed, consequences for sleep quality, and practical tips to improve sleep hygiene.
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨人们为何拖延上床睡觉、对睡眠质量的影响，以及改善睡眠卫生与就寝例行的可行建议。

items.title_en: GenRec: Towards LLM-Native Recommendation at Netflix
items.title_zh: GenRec：Netflix 的 LLM 原生推荐之路
items.summary_en: Netflix introduces GenRec, an approach to embed recommendations directly into an LLM-native pipeline. By unifying retrieval, ranking, and personalization under a model-centric flow, Netflix aims to simplify the stack and enable richer, more contextual suggestions.
items.summary_zh: Netflix 提出 GenRec，将推荐直接嵌入到 LLM 原生管线中。通过在统一的模型驱动流程中整合检索、排序与个性化，目标是简化技术栈并提供更丰富、情境化的推荐。

items.title_en: Dancing with friends and enemies: boids' swarm intelligence
items.title_zh: Boids 群体智能：与朋友和敌人的舞蹈
items.summary_en: It discusses dynamics when agents have aligned or opposing goals, and what this means for modeling decentralized systems.
items.summary_zh: 文章通过 boids 模型展示了简单局部规则如何产生群体聚合行为，以及在目标一致或冲突时的动态。讨论了对去中心化系统建模的启示。

items.title_en: TreasuryDirect: Prepare for ID.me – Your New Way to Log In
items.title_zh: TreasuryDirect：为 ID.me 做好登录准备——您的新登录方式
items.summary_en: TreasuryDirect shifts to ID.me as the new login method, aiming to streamline identity verification for savings bonds. The change improves authentication but requires users to adapt and consider privacy implications.
items.summary_zh: TreasuryDirect 将使用 ID.me 作为新的登录方式，旨在简化储蓄债券的身份验证。此变更提升了认证强度，但需要用户适应新流程并关注隐私影响。

items.title_en: OpenAI talent exodus raises 'huge red flag' ahead of IPO
items.title_zh: OpenAI 人才大举流失，为IPO提前敲响“巨大警报”
items.summary_en: OpenAI reportedly faces significant talent churn ahead of its IPO, signaling red flags about retention, incentives, or culture during scaling. The turnover could impact product momentum and investor confidence as the company grows.
items.summary_zh: 据报道，在公司准备上市之际，OpenAI 员工流失严重，这对留任、激励或企业文化等方面发出警示。人才流动可能影响产品进展与投资者信心，尤其在公司扩张阶段。

items.title_en: Access to telemetry data: Automotive industry criticizes intelligence reform
items.title_zh: 汽车行业对情报改革的遥测数据访问提出批评
items.summary_en: Automakers push back on intelligence reforms that would restrict access to vehicle telemetry, arguing it hampers diagnostics, safety improvements, and after-sales service. The debate centers on privacy versus innovation and repairability.
items.summary_zh: 汽车行业批评关于情报改革的提案限制对车辆遥测数据的访问，担忧诊断、改进安全性与售后服务能力受限。

items.title_en: Interview with Amit Patel, Creator of "Solar Realms Elite"
items.title_zh: Amit Patel：Solar Realms Elite 的创作访谈
items.summary_en: Amit Patel, designer of the early RPG Solar Realms Elite, discusses the game's creation, design decisions, and the indie scene of that era. He reflects on constraints, distribution, and the enduring influence of his project.
items.summary_zh: Amit Patel 讲述 Solar Realms Elite 的创作过程、设计决策，以及当时独立游戏的环境与挑战。 他回顾资源限制、发行方式，以及该作品带来的持续影响。

items.title_en: Targeted marine cloud brightening weakens subsequent El Niño
items.title_zh: 定向海洋云增亮削弱后续厄尔尼诺
items.summary_en: A targeted marine cloud brightening experiment suggests a potential climate intervention could modulate El Niño conditions in a controlled way. The study shows localized aerosol-induced cloud reflectivity can influence regional climate feedbacks, though deployment, ethics, and unintended consequences remain major concerns.
items.summary_zh: 一项定向海洋云增亮实验表明，局部气溶胶反射率的提升可能在受控条件下影响厄尔尼诺的强度与持续时间。研究揭示了区域气候反馈的潜在调控，但在部署、伦理和潜在副作用方面仍存在重大不确定性。

items.title_en: Red queen hypothesis – a new way forward for self-improving AI
items.title_zh: 红皇后假设：自我提升 AI 的新前路
items.summary_en: The piece reframes AI self-improvement through the Red Queen hypothesis, suggesting that continual improvement is driven by competitive dynamics rather than absolute progress. It explores implications for how self-improving systems might evolve and what safeguards may be needed.
items.summary_zh: 本文以红皇后假设为框架，讨论自我提升的 AI 如何在竞争环境中持续演化。分析潜在的演化路径及相关的安全与治理挑战。

items.title_en: Decoding smell: Study reveals how odor signals shapeshift in the wind
items.title_zh: 解码气味：研究揭示气味信号在风中如何被塑形
items.summary_en: A study maps how odor signals change shape as they travel with wind, revealing the physical dynamics behind olfactory perception and implications for sensing and navigation.
items.summary_zh: 研究揭示气味信号在风中的传播会被塑形、变化形态，揭示嗅觉感知背后的物理机制及其在 sensing 与导航方面的意义。

items.title_en: Show HN: Grafana agent observability for Hermes Agent
items.title_zh: Show HN：Hermes Agent 的 Grafana 观测代理
items.summary_en: A Show HN project demonstrates Grafana agent-based observability for the Hermes Agent, integrating metrics and accessibility-focused tooling. It highlights how lightweight agents can improve monitoring and diagnostics for specialized environments.
items.summary_zh: Show HN 展示了基于 Grafana 代理的 Hermes Agent 观测能力，整合指标与辅助工具，体现轻量代理在特定环境中的监控价值。

items.title_en: Show HN: PyScrappy, self-healing web scraping selectors plus an MCP server
items.title_zh: Show HN：PyScrappy — 自愈网页选择器与 MCP 服务器
items.summary_en: PyScrappy provides self-healing selectors for web scraping and ships an MCP server to orchestrate scraping tasks, reducing brittleness when sites change. A promising tool for developers building robust crawlers.
items.summary_zh: PyScrappy 提供自愈网页选择器并附带 MCP 服务器，用以协调抓取任务，减少站点改版带来的脆弱性。对需要稳定、可扩展数据抓取的开发者来说，是一个值得关注的工具。

items.title_en: Program with Paint Brushes, Not Pencils
items.title_zh: 用画笔而非铅笔编程
items.summary_en: A post advocates a painterly, high-level approach to programming, emphasizing design thinking and visual tools over line-by-line typing. It argues this mindset can improve intuition and reduce cognitive load.
items.summary_zh: 倡导以画笔般的思维来编程，强调设计思维和可视化工具对比逐字输入的优势，提升直觉和降低认知负担。

items.title_en: Modeling and Verification of Keeta's Consensus [pdf]
items.title_zh: Keeta 共识的建模与验证 [PDF]
items.summary_en: Modeling and verification of Keeta's consensus presents formal analysis of a consensus protocol, with modeling details and verification results in a PDF. The work highlights correctness guarantees for distributed systems.
items.summary_zh: Keeta 共识的建模与验证报告提供形式化分析与 PDF 资料，展示分布式系统一致性正确性证明的要点与结果。

items.title_en: 388 years ago, Galileo worked out why human giants can't exist
items.title_zh: 388 年前，伽利略算出人类巨人不可能存在的原因
items.summary_en: A historical explanation rooted in early physics showing why giant humans cannot exist, touching on gravity and scaling laws that limit size.
items.summary_zh: 基于早期物理学的解释，揭示为何人类巨人无法存在，涉及重力与尺度定律对体型的限制。

items.title_en: What I Learned Securing Sniffnet with the GitHub Secure Open Source Fund
items.title_zh: 通过 GitHub 安全开源基金保护 Sniffnet 的经验
items.summary_en: Securing Sniffnet benefited from GitHub's Secure Open Source Fund, enabling security audits and faster disclosure workflows. The post shares hands-on lessons about dependency hygiene, a responsible disclosure process, and building confidence for users.
items.summary_zh: 利用 GitHub 的安全开源基金对 Sniffnet 进行了安全审计与披露流程的改进，分享了依赖治理、漏洞披露等实战经验，提升用户信心。

items.title_en: The 37signals Manager Playbook
items.title_zh: 37signals 的管理者指南
items.summary_en: Basecamp's 37signals Manager Playbook lays out practical management principles focused on humane leadership, clear communication, and asynchronous collaboration. It offers concrete rules for team priorities, decision rights, and feedback loops that tech managers can apply.
items.summary_zh: Basecamp 的管理实践指南，强调以人为本的领导、清晰沟通和异步协作。提供面向产品团队的优先级设定、协作节奏与决策/反馈流程等实用原则，值得技术管理者借鉴。

items.title_en: In the Shadow of the (Berlin) Wall
items.title_zh: 在柏林墙的阴影下
items.summary_en: A Slow Travel piece explores Berlin’s history and the enduring shadow of the Berlin Wall, weaving personal travel impressions with historical context. It offers reflection on urban memory and how tech travelers interact with history.
items.summary_zh: 慢游文章将个人旅行感受与历史语境交织，探讨柏林墙的历史遗留与城市记忆，并思考科技旅行者如何与历史互动。

items.title_en: A Planet Position Widget
items.title_zh: 一个行星位置小组件
items.summary_en: A lightweight widget shows planetary positions for quick celestial context, appealing to hobbyists and educators. It demonstrates how small tools can complement full-featured planetarium software.
items.summary_zh: 一个轻量级的小组件展示行星位置，便于快速获取天体位置的背景信息，适合业余爱好者与教育用途，亦可作为完整行星仪软件的补充。

items.title_en: TSMC Uses Old Fabs to Make New Chips [video]
items.title_zh: 台积电利用老 fab 制造新芯片
items.summary_en: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. leverages older fabs to produce newer chips, illustrating how mature manufacturing assets can still be repurposed for cutting-edge designs. The move highlights supply-chain flexibility and capital-light strategies for device scaling.
items.summary_zh: 台积电利用较旧的 fabs 来制造新芯片，展示了对成熟产线再利用的能力与灵活性。此举凸显了供应链弹性及以更低资本改造产线以支持新一代设计的策略。

items.title_en: z486: A 486-Class Pipelined FPGA CPU with Integrated Floating-Point
items.title_zh: z486：集成浮点的 486 级流水线 FPGA CPU
items.summary_en: z486 is an FPGA-based CPU that implements 486-class pipelining with integrated floating-point, showcasing retro hardware design blended with modern FPGA techniques.
items.summary_zh: z486 是一款基于 FPGA 的 CPU，实现 486 级流水线并集成浮点运算，展示了复古硬件设计与现代 FPGA 技术的融合。

items.title_en: AGI-64 Brings Sierra Adventures to the Commodore 64
items.title_zh: AGI-64 把 Sierra 冒险带进 Commodore 64
items.summary_en: AGI-64 ports Sierra's AGI-era adventure games to the Commodore 64 by reimplementing the engine for the classic hardware. The project demonstrates how modern tooling can revive beloved titles on constrained machines and highlight retro-game preservation challenges.
items.summary_zh: AGI-64 通过为 Commodore 64 重新实现 AGI 引擎，将 Sierra 的 AGI 时代冒险游戏移植上去。该项目展示了现代工具如何让经典作品在受限硬件上重现，同时揭示了复古游戏保存的挑战。

items.title_en: Speaking for the Dead
items.title_zh: 为死者发声：讣告中的长篇报道
items.summary_en: A Longreads feature on obituaries explores how obits shape memory, public narratives, and the way we remember notable lives. It reflects on voice, editorial choices, and cultural significance.
items.summary_zh: 长篇报道探讨讣告如何塑造记忆与公共叙事，及其在文化语境中的作用与编辑选择的影响。

items.title_en: Physicists discover a hidden gluon structure inside protons
items.title_zh: 质子内部的隐藏胶子结构
items.summary_en: New results indicate a hidden gluon substructure inside protons, shedding light on how gluons arrange themselves within nucleons. The finding helps refine quantum chromodynamics models and could impact high-energy physics predictions.
items.summary_zh: 研究揭示质子内部存在隐藏的胶子结构，通过高能实验证据揭示胶子在质子中的排列方式。这一发现有助于改进量子色动力学模型，并可能影响高能物理的预测。

items.title_en: Stop Turning every purchase into a tip request
items.title_zh: 别把每次购买都变成要小费的请求
items.summary_en: An op-ed argues against making every purchase elicit a tipping request, calling for clearer pricing and less friction for consumers. It touches on consumer psychology, merchant economics, and the practical implications for software and platform UX.
items.summary_zh: 专栏批评把每次购买都变成要小费的场景，主张应有更清晰的定价与更少的用户阻力，讨论了消费者心理、商家经济学以及对软件与平台用户体验的实际影响。

items.title_en: How a Sony Veteran Is Overhauling the Company He Grew Up In
items.title_zh: 一位索尼资深高管正在推翻他成长的公司
items.summary_en: A Sony veteran is steering a major turnaround, aligning electronics, gaming, and entertainment businesses with a tighter strategy and renewed investment in core strengths. The piece sheds light on leadership challenges at a legacy tech giant.
items.summary_zh: 一位索尼资深高管正在推动公司改革，聚焦核心优势、资源再配置和战略调整，以应对行业变革。

items.title_en: Our Reality Is Shifting and It's Just the Start
items.title_zh: 我们的现实正在发生改变，这只是开始
items.summary_en: The piece argues that rapid tech shifts—AI, automation, and digital infrastructure—are accelerating, signaling only the beginning of a broader transformation. It considers implications for work, governance, and personal identity.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为 AI、自动化等技术变革正在加速，未来才刚刚开始，讨论对工作、治理和个人身份的潜在影响。

items.title_en: Show HN: Continuum – Financial simulations for DIY multimillionaires
items.title_zh: Show HN: Continuum — 面向 DIY 富豪的金融仿真
items.summary_en: Show HN: Continuum offers financial simulations tailored for high-net-worth individuals who want to DIY wealth management. It provides scenario modeling and risk assessment to experiment with investment ideas before committing.
items.summary_zh: Show HN：Continuum 提供面向高净值个人的金融模拟工具，方便自行管理财富。通过场景建模和风险评估，用户可以在落地投资前试验策略。

items.title_en: Testing Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 Inside Claude Code
items.title_zh: 在 Claude Code 中测试 Moonshot AI 的 Kimi K3
items.summary_en: A hands-on look at running Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 inside Claude Code, evaluating code generation capabilities, reliability, and integration quirks. The post helps gauge how competing AI coding tools perform in real-world coding environments.
items.summary_zh: 在 Claude Code 中测试 Moonshot AI 的 Kimi K3，评估代码生成功能、稳定性以及在 IDE 场景中的集成情况，帮助读者比较工具。

items.title_en: The FastLanes Unified Transport Layout
items.title_zh: FastLanes 统一传输布局
items.summary_en: Introduces FastLanes Unified Transport Layout, a design concept intended to simplify and accelerate data or vehicle transport by unifying routing and interfaces. The proposal argues for modular, high-throughput pathways to reduce bottlenecks and improve throughput.
items.summary_zh: 介绍 FastLanes 统一传输布局，一种旨在简化并提升数据或车辆传输的设计概念，通过统一路由和接口来减少瓶颈、提升吞吐。该方案主张模块化、高吞吐的通道，以降低瓶颈并提高扩展性。
